Before agreement can be used as a training signal, one must separate recurring true confidence from recurring false certainty. The contribution is moderate in scale but strong as a careful negative audit of a common engineering heuristic.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study is built around a cross-runner audit rather than a single benchmark run. Fifty-three runners produced overlapping evaluations, each comparing two controlled conditions along one axis, with K=50 samples per case at temperature 1.0. The three axes are: model tier within the gpt-4.1 family (nano vs mini), prompting strategy (mini zero-shot vs mini chain-of-thought), and mid-tier versus frontier (mini vs gpt-4.1). Because multiple runners evaluate overlapping cases and each runner uses their own prompt wording, the setup creates natural replication across prompts and execution styles. That is what allows the authors to distinguish stochastic confident errors from recurring confident errors.

The analysis centers on explicit agreement and accuracy statistics, including per-case self-consistency strength and majority-vote outcomes. The paper uses hierarchical runner-clustered bootstrap with multiplicity control, which is important because the data are not cleanly iid: runners share a course context and may have shared code or discussion. The statistical framing is more careful than in many benchmark-style papers.

Two controls are especially informative. First, the recurrence analysis asks whether the same wrong answer reappears across runners and prompts, which is evidence for systematic bias rather than sampling noise. Second, the GPQA option-shuffle control tests whether apparent confidence is partly driven by answer-position priors. This is a strong design choice because multiple-choice tasks can artificially inflate agreement through constrained answer geometry. The paper also includes an exploratory cross-family check with Claude tiers, asking whether shared confident errors extend across providers rather than only within a single model family.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments use GPQA Diamond and AIME, which intentionally span opposite ends of the answer-space spectrum. GPQA is four-way multiple choice, so agreement has a nontrivial floor even under weak reasoning. AIME uses integer answers from 0 to 999, so high agreement is much harder to obtain without actual reasoning competence. This benchmark pairing is central to the paper’s argument because it shows how the usefulness of agreement depends on answer-space structure.

Several findings stand out. First, majority-vote self-consistency still improves accuracy, which is consistent with prior work. But the stronger claim people often make—that the degree of agreement itself is a reliable confidence score—is only weakly supported. The signal is somewhat useful in unsaturated mid-tier regimes, where agreement still varies meaningfully with competence. It becomes much less useful for the frontier model, which is more consistent but not proportionally more accurate.

Second, chain-of-thought prompting improves task accuracy but only marginally improves the agreement-correctness relationship. That is an important distinction. Better reasoning does not automatically imply better calibration of agreement as confidence.

Third, a confidence-routed cascade performs poorly and is dominated by simply always using the mid-tier model. This is one of the most practically relevant negative results in the paper: if routing relies on a weak confidence proxy, sending examples to a more expensive frontier model can be counterproductive.

Fourth, the option-shuffle control on GPQA shows that some of the apparent confidence is positional rather than epistemic. That result is especially important for multiple-choice evaluation and for any judge pipeline that interprets repeated agreement too literally.

Finally, the exploratory Claude-based replication is directionally consistent with the GPT-family findings. The paper reports that smaller GPT and Claude tiers choose the same wrong answers more often than a marginal-preserving null would predict, suggesting that cross-model agreement can also reflect shared bias rather than truth.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and setup to avoid a common misread: the paper is not arguing that self-consistency decoding is useless. It is asking whether agreement can be trusted as confidence. Then focus on the definitions of the agreement and accuracy variables, the paired comparisons along each axis, and the plots for mini versus gpt-4.1. If reading selectively, four parts matter most: the benchmark choice and answer-space argument, the recurrence analysis, the option-shuffle control, and the confidence-routed cascade results. Those sections carry most of the paper’s real insight. A useful reading lens is to ask what exactly causes frontier-model agreement to saturate: improved competence, reduced entropy, stylistic collapse from post-training, or some mixture of the three. The paper does not fully resolve that mechanism, but it provides enough evidence to make the question concrete. Around 25 to 35 minutes is enough for a solid skim.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 rho≈0.20 的分解；它会降低对 judge ensemble 置信度估计的信任。
recommendation.en: Read the design and the rho≈0.20 breakdown; it should reduce trust in judge-ensemble confidence estimates.

paper.title: When Does Continual Learning Require Learning
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the next question is how can we enable models to continually learn? Today, the field largely frames this as a problem of context management and mitigating forgetting. We argue this framing is incomplete: continual learning is fundamentally about increasing model competence as the world changes. We disentangle this change along two axes -- space, where the model encounters new domains, and time, where the underlying data drifts under a

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM持续学习研究大多将问题框定为缓解灾难性遗忘，或完全依赖上下文管理、检索增强规避权重更新，缺少统一评测框架在接近真实部署的条件下公平对比提示优化、参数更新、上下文压缩等不同技术路线的方法，无法回答不同分布偏移场景下各方法的适用边界，以及什么时候必须通过模型更新实现持续学习。
summary.importance: 将持续学习的定义从“避免遗忘”修正为“在变化的环境中持续提升能力”，拆分出空间（新领域偏移）、时间（固定任务下的数据漂移，包含慢趋势适配、离散事实更新、智能体自驱状态累积三类子场景）两个维度的环境变化，为持续预训练、持续后训练研究提供了更贴近落地需求的评测基准。跨方法族的对比结论清晰给出了不同技术路线的取舍边界，可为部署方案选型提供直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义持续学习为环境变化过程中的模型能力提升，将环境变化拆解为两个轴：空间轴对应传统的领域/任务分布偏移，时间轴对应固定任务下的数据漂移，进一步拆分为慢趋势适应、离散事实更新、模型自身动作导致的智能体状态累积三类子场景。随后设计机制无关的统一顺序评测协议，将现有通用LLM基准改造为随时间逐步展开的任务序列，在相同的Qwen3-8B底座上，对4大类共8种方法（提示优化、离线有监督更新、在线RL、上下文压缩）开展公平对比，覆盖领域适配、智能体交互、金融时序分析、时间敏感知识更新四类任务。
summary.experiments: 核心跨方法对比结论：1）提示优化类方法（GEPA、ACE）对历史轨迹拟合速度快，向后传输准确率高，但在未来任务上性能急剧衰减，存在对历史轨迹的过拟合；2）蒸馏类方法（SDFT、SDPO）的知识累积过程更稳定，但无法快速融入新信息、校正过时知识；3）上下文压缩类方法（Cartridges、In-place TTT）主要提升内存使用效率，对新任务学习能力无实质增益；4）在线RL类方法（GRPO）在知识更新任务上表现最优，但对奖励信号的噪声与不稳定性高度敏感；5）在智能体状态累积场景下，基于提示的操作手册方法（ACE）和基于权重更新的SFT都可以累积交互经验，在所有交互链长度下均优于零样本基线，但绝对性能仍会随交互链长度增加而衰减。整体结论为：纯提示方法在大部分真实持续学习场景下能力不足，方法选择需要与目标场景的空间/时间偏移类型匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对持续学习问题的维度拆分、结果部分的跨方法取舍总结，无需深入了解每个对比方法的实现细节，核心收获是不同偏移类型对应的最优方法族映射，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM continual learning research largely frames the problem as catastrophic forgetting mitigation, or avoids weight updates entirely via context management and retrieval augmentation. No unified evaluation framework enables fair comparison across prompt optimization, parametric update, and context compression approaches under realistic deployment conditions, leaving unclear the boundary conditions for each method and when actual model learning is strictly required.
summary_en.importance: This work reframes continual learning as competence gain in a changing environment rather than mere forgetting avoidance, and decomposes real-world shift into two axes: spatial (new domain/task shift) and temporal (fixed-task drift including slow trend adaptation, discrete fact updates, and agentic state accumulation from the model's own actions). This framing and associated benchmark provide a more deployment-relevant evaluation setup for continual pretraining and post-training research. The cross-method comparison results outline clear tradeoffs across technical approaches to support practical deployment decision-making.
summary_en.technical_approach: First formalize continual learning as improving model competence as the environment evolves, with change decomposed along two axes: space for classical domain/task distribution shift, and time for fixed-task drift, further split into slow trend adaptation, discrete fact update, and agentic state accumulation. Then design a mechanism-agnostic sequential evaluation protocol that adapts standard LLM benchmarks into temporally unfolding task sequences, enabling apples-to-apples comparison of 8 methods across 4 families (prompt optimization, offline supervised update, online RL, context compression) on a shared Qwen3-8B backbone, spanning domain adaptation, agentic web tasks, financial time series analysis, and time-stamped knowledge update tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Key cross-method findings: 1) Prompt optimization approaches (GEPA, ACE) fit quickly to past trajectories with strong backward accuracy, but suffer sharp degradation on future tasks due to overfitting to historical context; 2) Distillation-based methods (SDFT, SDPO) accumulate knowledge stably over time, but fail to rapidly incorporate new information or correct outdated beliefs; 3) Context compression approaches (Cartridges, In-place TTT) improve memory efficiency but deliver no substantial gain on new task learning; 4) Online RL methods (GRPO) achieve the best performance on knowledge update tasks, but are highly sensitive to reward noise and instability; 5) On agentic state accumulation tasks, both prompt-based playbooks (ACE) and weight-based SFT compound experience to outperform zero-shot baselines at all interaction chain lengths, though absolute performance still decays as chain length grows. The core takeaway is that prompt-only approaches are insufficient for most real-world continual learning regimes, and method selection should be matched to the specific type of temporal or spatial shift in the target deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a framework and empirical comparison paper. Focus on the problem decomposition in the introduction and the cross-method tradeoff summary in the results section; there is no need to dive into implementation details of each compared method. The key high-value takeaway is the mapping between shift type and best-performing method family. Expected reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 持续学习的两轴拆解比常见遗忘视角更贴近持续预训练真实需求，重点读 §3 的评测协议设计与不同方法族的横向对比。
recommendation.en: The two-axis decomposition of continual learning is closer to real continual pretraining needs than the usual forgetting perspective; focus on §3 for the evaluation protocol and cross-family comparison.

paper.title: Evaluating LLM Uncertainty in Long-Form Generation Using Deterministic Ground Truth
paper.abstract: As LLMs generate increasingly long outputs, effective uncertainty estimation must identify errors at fine-grained levels rather than discard entire responses. While such methods exist, evaluating uncertainty at any resolution (token to an entire generation) is challenging and highly sensitive to label imperfections, making zero-noise benchmarks essential; yet, long-form generation benchmarks tend to rely on fallible labels rather than deterministic ground truth. We introduce Single-answer Atomic

summary.core_problem: 长文本生成场景下的细粒度不确定性评估缺乏无噪声基准。现有长文本基准依赖易错的人工或LLM生成标签，输出分解与验证环节的噪声会扭曲不确定性度量、系统性偏差排序指标，同时无法支持从原子单元到完整响应的多粒度精确评估。
summary.importance: 提供了无噪、可无限生成、抗污染的长文本细粒度不确定性评估基准，可用于预训练或后训练阶段模型校准效果的精确验证；对50+模型的实测揭示的推理权衡、细粒度置信度失效模式等结论，为理解LLM不确定性行为、设计预训练校准方法提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: SALT包含6个程序生成的任务，覆盖逻辑、数学、代码、翻译、多针插草堆等领域，每个任务都有唯一确定性的长文本基准真值，无需外部评审。它支持多粒度的正确性、校准与排序评估，可生成近乎无限的实例以避免模型进化带来的基准污染。
summary.experiments: 评估了50余款主流LLM，包括GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-Pro、Qwen-3、GLM-4.7、MiniMax M2.5。核心发现包括：1）推理机制（思维链/推理模型）存在“推理权衡”：提升生成精度的同时会系统性损害置信度排序能力；2）置信度排序存在高分辨率失效模式：原始置信度信号经常无法区分正确与错误的原子单元，即便粗粒度排序仍有信息量；3）未来生成的正确性由两个可分离的因素驱动：前缀错误的传播（由全局而非局部上下文正确性主导），以及答案上下文长度增加带来的有限退化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第1节研究动机与现有方法局限、SALT基准的任务设计与生成方式章节、实验部分的核心发现。跳过各个任务的具体实现细节、完整的模型性能表格与细碎的消融结果。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Fine-grained uncertainty estimation for long-form LLM generation lacks zero-noise evaluation benchmarks. Existing long-form benchmarks rely on fallible human or LLM-generated labels, where noise from output decomposition and verification distorts uncertainty metrics and systematically biases ranking metrics like AUROC. Multi-granularity evaluation spanning atomic units to full responses also cannot be reliably supported under current paradigms.
summary_en.importance: Presents SALT, a contamination-free, deterministically generated benchmark for fine-grained long-form uncertainty evaluation that enables precise measurement of LLM calibration and ranking across granularities. Empirical findings from 50+ models, including reasoning trade-offs and fine-grained confidence failure modes, provide empirical reference for designing pretraining calibration methods and understanding LLM uncertainty behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SALT comprises six procedurally generated tasks covering logic, mathematics, code, translation, and multi-needle-in-haystack, each with a single deterministic long-form ground truth that requires no external judges. It supports multi-granularity evaluation of correctness, calibration, and ranking, with effectively unlimited instance generation to avoid benchmark contamination as models evolve.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated over 50 contemporary LLMs including GPT-5.1, Gemini-3-Pro, Qwen-3, GLM-4.7, and MiniMax M2.5. Key insights: 1) Reasoning mechanisms (CoT/reasoning models) introduce a "reasoning trade-off" that improves precision but systematically degrades confidence ranking; 2) Confidence ranking exhibits a high-resolution failure mode where raw confidence signals fail to separate correct from incorrect atomic units even when coarser-grained ranking remains informative; 3) Future correctness is driven by two separable factors: error propagation from corrupted prefixes (dominated by global rather than local context correctness) and bounded degradation from increasing answer-context length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 (motivation and limitations of prior work), the SALT benchmark design and task generation section, and key experimental findings. Skip detailed task implementation, exhaustive model performance tables, and granular ablation results. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 设计和 atomic-vs-line 结果；它会修正对长文本置信度可迁移性的乐观假设。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and atomic-vs-line results; it tempers the usual optimism about transferable confidence scores in long-form generation.

paper.title: Consistent but Miscalibrated: Evaluating LLM Limitations for Risk Communication in Natural Language
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed as post-hoc explainers of AI-generated outputs, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably communicate probabilistic information in natural language. For this role to be viable, models must produce identical verbal descriptions for identical inputs, and select descriptions that accurately reflect the magnitude of the underlying numerical quantities. We evaluate whether nine LLMs meet these requirements within a two-stage prediction pipeline, in which an upstr

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 能否把上游模型的概率和不确定性，用稳定且校准的自然语言风险描述表达出来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测与可靠性分析。它关注 LLM 作为后验解释器时的自然语言概率校准问题，对安全评估和模型输出解释有用，但与预训练 recipe 的连接较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 构造两阶段预测管线：先用 Beta 分布按 mode 和 prior sample size 模拟上游模型概率输出，再要求 LLM 在六个领域语境和十个 temperature 设置下选择自然语言描述，并重复实验以测量一致性和校准性。
summary.experiments: 评估九个 LLM，每个条件重复十次。主要发现是模型通常能给出一致描述，但描述与真实概率幅度存在校准偏差。摘要未列出具体模型名单、误差指标和逐模型结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 McGill University、Chandar Research Lab、Polytechnique Montréal、Mila，Sarath Chandar 是 Mila / CIFAR AI Chair 相关研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can express upstream probabilistic predictions and uncertainty in natural language both consistently and with proper calibration.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and reliability-analysis contribution. It is relevant to LLMs as post-hoc explainers of model outputs, though its connection to pretraining recipes is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a two-stage prediction pipeline: upstream probabilistic outputs are simulated from Beta distributions parameterized by mode and prior sample size, and LLMs are prompted to choose verbal descriptors under six domain contexts and ten temperature settings, with repeated trials to measure consistency and calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Nine LLMs are evaluated, with each experiment repeated ten times. The main reported finding is that models are generally consistent but miscalibrated in mapping probabilities to verbal risk descriptors. The abstract does not list the exact models, metrics, or per-model numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with McGill University, Chandar Research Lab, Polytechnique Montréal, and Mila. Sarath Chandar is associated with Mila and CIFAR AI Chair.

recommendation.zh: 结论像一个可靠性 sanity check；看实验设计即可，别把它外推到预训练校准机制。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reliability sanity check; read the setup, but do not over-interpret it as pretraining calibration theory.

institutions: Mila – Québec Artificial Intelligence Institute, Montréal, H2S 3H1
Chandar Research Lab, Polytechnique Montréal, Montréal, H3T 1J4

paper.title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Ontology learning (OL) aims to automatically construct structured knowledge models from text, yet progress remains fragmented across methods, domains, and evaluation practices. Despite decades of research, OL lacks a shared infrastructure for systematic evaluation and ontology access. This absence has hindered progress and fragmented research, leaving the central challenges of OL largely unaddressed. We introduce OntoLearner, a modular, cross-domain, and first-of-its-kind framework that unifies

summary.core_problem: Ontology learning 研究缺少统一的本体访问、任务数据和评测基础设施，导致方法难以系统比较。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测与基础设施：发布 180 个机器可读 ontology，覆盖 22 个领域，并为 term typing、taxonomy discovery、non-taxonomic relation extraction 提供 pipeline-ready 数据划分。对基座预训练不是核心相关，但对知识抽取、结构化知识评测和 RAG 知识层构建有备查价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OntoLearner Python 库，统一 ontology 访问、LLM 驱动的 ontology learning pipeline 和标准化 benchmark。系统支持跨领域任务，并把检索模型和 LLM 放在同一基础设施中评测。
summary.experiments: 评测 22 个 retrieval models 和 12 个 LLMs，覆盖 22 个领域和 3 类 ontology learning 任务。摘要未提供具体模型清单、最佳结果、提升幅度或误差分析细节。
summary.authors_note: Sören Auer 是语义网和知识图谱领域知名研究者。题录未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Ontology learning lacks shared ontology access, task datasets, and evaluation infrastructure, making systematic comparison difficult.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation and infrastructure asset: 180 machine-readable ontologies across 22 domains, with pipeline-ready splits for term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction. It is not central to base-model pretraining, but it is useful as a reference for knowledge extraction, structured-knowledge evaluation, and RAG knowledge-layer construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: OntoLearner is a Python library that unifies ontology access, LLM-driven ontology learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking. It supports cross-domain tasks and evaluates retrieval models and LLMs under the same infrastructure.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study evaluates 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs across 22 domains and three ontology-learning tasks. The abstract does not provide the model list, top-line numbers, improvement margins, or detailed error analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: Sören Auer is a well-known researcher in the Semantic Web and knowledge graph community. Full affiliations are not available in the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 作为知识结构化评测资产记下即可；预训练侧只需关心任务定义和数据划分，方法结论不必深读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a structured-knowledge evaluation asset; for pretraining work, only the task definitions and splits are worth noting.

paper.title: Testing Frontier Large Language Models' Physics Literacy in Parallel Physical Worlds
paper.abstract: Current large-language-model (LLM) physics benchmarks are usually scored by answer accuracy, which cannot distinguish genuine reasoning from recall of familiar problem patterns and reveals little about where a model's reasoning breaks down. We introduce an auditable four-stage diagnostic that evaluates whether an LLM can reason inside an unfamiliar physics framework through induction, formulation, prediction, and review. The diagnostic combines locked pre-registrations, fresh sessions between st

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题不是“模型能否答对物理题”，而是“模型能否在陌生物理规则中完成可审计的理论建构”。作者认为常规物理 benchmark 主要看最终答案，容易混入训练集记忆、题型模板匹配和熟悉公式套用，无法定位推理在哪一步失效。因此他们设计了一个四阶段诊断流程，要求模型先从观察中归纳规则，再形式化理论，再预测新情形，最后审查自己的理论与预测。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测信号质量。它把物理能力评测从答案准确率推进到“分阶段、可审计、抗记忆”的诊断。对基座模型研究员来说，价值不在物理题本身，而在评测范式：如果想区分预训练中形成的抽象推理能力和后训练中学到的答题模板，需要构造模型不熟悉但规则清晰的平行世界，并把归纳、建模、预测、反思分开观察。这类评测更适合研究 scaling、数据污染、CoT 可靠性、RL 后训练是否强化真实推理等问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是四阶段 diagnostic。第一阶段是 induction，模型从给定观测中归纳规则；第二阶段是 formulation，模型把规则写成可检查的理论或方程；第三阶段是 prediction，模型用自己形成的理论预测新场景；第四阶段是 review，模型检查前面理论和预测的一致性。作者用三类“平行物理世界”降低记忆风险：一个单方程反事实世界 F=mv，一个历史物理框架 Aristotelian mechanics，以及包含四个领域规则的 Decay World。流程上使用 locked pre-registration 固定题目和评分标准，不同阶段之间开启 fresh session，减少模型把前一阶段对话状态当作捷径；评分采用双 LLM judging，并保留 human audit pathway，用来处理自动评审不稳定和边界案例。与传统 benchmark 的区别是，它不把正确答案作为唯一目标，而是把理论生成过程拆成多个可以单独失败的环节。
summary.experiments: 实验对象包括 Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5 等前沿模型。论文关注的主要结果是模型在陌生规则下的分阶段表现，而不是单一准确率。作者报告这些模型可以在部分简单反事实规则中表现出归纳和预测能力，但在更复杂的 Decay World 中容易出现规则遗漏、局部一致但全局不一致、预测时回退到现实物理直觉、以及 review 阶段不能可靠发现自身理论缺陷等问题。给定内容未提供完整表格数字，因此精读时需要直接核对各世界、各阶段、各模型的通过率、judge 一致性和人工审计修正比例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看三部分：第一，看任务设计，尤其是三种平行物理世界如何避免训练集记忆和公式套用；第二，看四阶段流程与 locked pre-registration、fresh session、dual-LLM judging 的实现细节，这部分对构造 reasoning eval 有直接参考价值；第三，看 failure taxonomy，尤其是模型从 induction 到 prediction 的错误迁移。若时间有限，可跳过 AI for science 的背景铺垫，直接读方法、评分协议和各模型失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more specific question than whether an LLM can answer physics problems. It asks whether a model can build an auditable theory inside an unfamiliar physical framework. Standard physics benchmarks mostly score final-answer accuracy, which mixes genuine reasoning with memorized problem patterns and familiar formula use. The proposed diagnostic separates induction, formalization, prediction, and self-review, so failures can be localized rather than hidden behind a single score.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is in evaluation design. The paper provides a way to probe whether a base or post-trained model has acquired reusable abstraction, rather than only surface-level problem templates. By using unfamiliar but well-defined physical worlds, it reduces the role of memorization and data contamination. This makes the setup relevant for studying scaling effects, chain-of-thought reliability, post-training effects on reasoning, and whether RL-style training improves true rule induction or only improves answer presentation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The diagnostic has four stages. In the induction stage, the model infers rules from observations. In the formulation stage, it expresses those rules as a checkable theory or set of equations. In the prediction stage, it applies the induced theory to new cases. In the review stage, it audits its own theory and predictions for consistency. The paper instantiates the protocol in three parallel physical worlds: a single-equation counterfactual world with F=mv, a historical framework based on Aristotelian mechanics, and a more complex four-domain Decay World. The protocol uses locked pre-registrations, fresh sessions between stages, dual-LLM judging, and a human-audit path. This differs from ordinary benchmarks by testing the construction and use of a theory, not only the final answer.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluated models include Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, among other frontier systems. The central findings are stage-wise rather than a single leaderboard result. The models can sometimes infer and use simple counterfactual rules, but they become less reliable in richer worlds such as Decay World. Reported failure modes include missing rules, locally coherent but globally inconsistent theories, reverting to real-world physics priors during prediction, and weak self-review when earlier formulations are flawed. The provided content does not include complete numeric tables, so the key items to verify in the full paper are pass rates by world and stage, judge agreement, and the rate of human-audit corrections.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read of 25–35 minutes is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the construction of the three parallel worlds, the four-stage protocol, and the judging/audit design. The most reusable part is the separation of induction, formulation, prediction, and review under fresh-session constraints. The background discussion on AI for science can be read lightly unless the reader is specifically interested in scientific autonomy benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 用反事实场景剥离记忆的评测思路非常有价值，应参考其四阶段流程设计内部推理能力评测，重点看§3的诊断协议
recommendation.en: The evaluation idea of stripping memorization via counterfactual scenarios is highly valuable; reference its four-stage pipeline for internal reasoning ability evaluation, focus on §3 for the diagnostic protocol

paper.title: When Calibration Rankings Reverse: Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation for Fair Comparison of LLMs
paper.abstract: Calibration evaluates whether a model confidence aligns with its empirical accuracy. Existing studies often compare the calibration of different large language models using global calibration metrics such as Expected Calibration Error and Brier Score. We begin by showing, both theoretically and empirically, that such comparisons are confounded by differences in model accuracy. For fairer cross-model comparison, we then propose ACE, an accuracy-controlled evaluation framework with three complemen

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM 校准评测中的一个基本偏差：不同模型准确率不同时，直接比较 ECE、Brier Score 等全局校准指标，会把“模型更少犯错”和“置信度更可信”混在一起。结果是校准排序可能反转，原本看起来校准更好的模型，在控制准确率后反而更差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练方法，而在模型评测协议。它提醒基座模型比较不能只看 raw calibration metric，尤其是在比较不同规模模型、reasoning/thinking 模型与普通模型时，准确率差异会系统性影响校准结论。这个问题会影响模型选择、风险评估、RL/SFT 后模型可靠性分析，以及 confidence elicitation 方法的比较。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 ACE，即 Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation。它不提出新的校准算法，而是提出更公平的比较方式。ACE 有三个视角：Instance-Aligned 只在两个模型结果相同的样本上比较置信度行为，控制最严格；Distribution-Aligned 匹配两个模型在正确/错误结果上的总体组成，保留更多样本，牺牲一部分实例级控制；Candidate-Aligned 用于共享候选答案空间的评估场景，让不同模型在同一批候选答案上判断置信度。三者共同目标是把“任务准确率”从“校准质量”里拆开。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 GPQA、LiveBench、MMLU、FreshQA、TriviaQA 等数据集，比较不同模型族、不同 confidence elicitation 方法，以及小模型/大模型、thinking/non-thinking 模型。一个关键结果是 raw ECE 差异与准确率差异高度相关：Figure 1 中模型对的准确率差与 raw ECE 差的 Spearman 相关为 ρ=-0.670，n=40，95% CI [-0.81, -0.45]，p<1e-5。控制准确率后相关性明显下降：Distribution-Aligned 为 ρ=-0.232 且不显著，Instance-Aligned 为 ρ=-0.174 且不显著；Candidate-Aligned 仍有一定相关，ρ=-0.454。实验还显示，许多 raw metric 下的校准优势在 ACE 下缩小，部分比较出现 ranking reversal。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看引言中的反例和 Figure 1，它说明为什么 raw ECE/BS 不能直接跨模型比较。然后看 ACE 三个视角的定义，关注它们各自控制了什么、损失了什么。实验部分建议只抓两类比较：规模比较和 thinking/non-thinking 比较。最值得带走的是评测设计原则：校准比较要先说明是否控制准确率，否则结论容易把能力差异误读成校准差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a confound in LLM calibration evaluation: when two models differ in accuracy, global metrics such as ECE and Brier Score do not isolate calibration quality. A stronger model can look better calibrated partly because it makes fewer mistakes. This can lead to ranking reversals after accuracy is controlled.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation methodology rather than pretraining itself. It is relevant for comparing base models, post-trained models, reasoning models, and different confidence elicitation schemes. The result cautions against treating raw calibration metrics as directly comparable across models with different task accuracies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is ACE, or Accuracy-Controlled Evaluation. It contains three complementary views. Instance-Aligned calibration compares models only on examples where they share the same correctness outcome, giving strict instance-level control. Distribution-Aligned calibration matches the aggregate mixture of correct and incorrect cases, keeping broader coverage while relaxing instance matching. Candidate-Aligned calibration applies the same idea when models evaluate a shared candidate answer pool. The method does not recalibrate models; it changes the comparison protocol so that calibration behavior is less entangled with accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study spans GPQA, LiveBench, MMLU, FreshQA, TriviaQA, multiple model families, and several confidence elicitation methods. A central result is that raw ECE differences are strongly correlated with accuracy differences across model pairs: Figure 1 reports Spearman ρ=-0.670 over n=40 dataset-level comparisons, with 95% CI [-0.81, -0.45] and p<1e-5. After accuracy control, the correlation is much weaker for Distribution-Aligned calibration, ρ=-0.232 and not significant, and for Instance-Aligned calibration, ρ=-0.174 and not significant. Candidate-Aligned calibration still shows a moderate residual relation, ρ=-0.454. The experiments also show that apparent calibration advantages often shrink, and ranking reversals appear in both scale-based and thinking-versus-non-thinking comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Start with the motivating example and Figure 1, since they make the accuracy confound concrete. Then read the definitions of the three ACE views and compare their assumptions. In the experiments, focus on the scale comparison and thinking/non-thinking comparison. The useful takeaway is a protocol-level one: calibration claims should state whether accuracy was controlled, otherwise model capability differences may be misread as calibration differences.

recommendation.zh: 读 ACE 三种对齐和 ranking reversal 结果；它会改变直接看 ECE/Brier 比模型校准的习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the three ACE alignments and the ranking-reversal results; it should weaken trust in raw ECE/Brier comparisons.

paper.title: CDR-Bench: Evaluating Faithful Execution of Compositional, Order-Sensitive Data Refinement Recipes
paper.abstract: Data refinement involves executing multi-step recipes over evolving text states, where both composition and execution order of processing operators determine the outcome. While existing benchmarks either isolate text editing or entangle it with code and tool execution, it remains unclear whether LLMs can directly and faithfully execute these compositional, order-sensitive data refinement recipes. To fill this gap, we introduce CDR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 3,462 high-quality tas

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评测 LLM 是否能直接、忠实地执行组合式且顺序敏感的数据清洗与数据改写 recipe，而不是只完成单个文本编辑操作，或依赖代码工具链间接完成任务。
summary.importance: 它和预训练数据研究有较强关系。现代语料构建越来越多地使用 LLM 做清洗、过滤、PII 脱敏、RAG 文档整理和格式规整，但这些操作通常是多步流程，并且中间状态会影响后续步骤。CDR-Bench 提供了一个可复现诊断：模型是否真的按顺序执行数据处理 recipe，而不是生成一个看起来合理的最终文本。这对用 LLM 构建或审计预训练数据 pipeline 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CDR-Bench 把数据 refinement 形式化为有序 operator 序列。operator 分为两类：mapper 负责按规则改写文本，filter 负责输出 KEEP 或 DROP。给定输入文本和自然语言 recipe，模型需要输出最终状态和最终文本；参考答案由确定性执行器生成，因此可以做 exact evaluation，而不依赖 LLM judge。数据集包含 3,462 个任务，覆盖 Web Refinement、LaTeX Refinement、RAG Preparation、Privacy Redaction 四个领域，包含 29 种 operator 和 63 个 recipe template。评测轨道包括 Atomic-M、Atomic-F、Agnostic-M、Order-M、Order-F，用来区分单步执行、顺序不敏感组合执行和顺序敏感组合执行。指标包括 Recipe Success、Order-Consistent Success 和 Refinement Gain。
summary.experiments: 实验评测了 10 多个强 LLM。主要结果是，单 operator 表现不能预测组合 recipe 表现；模型常生成表面合理的输出，但实际违反指定顺序。在顺序敏感组上，所有测试顺序都解对的比例很低：Order-M 低于 5%，Order-F 低于 19%。filter 的位置尤其脆弱：把 filter 从一串 transformation 之前移动到之后，exact recipe success 会下降超过 47 个百分点。prompt engineering 和 few-shot demonstration 不能完全弥合这一差距。这个结果说明，数据 refinement 的难点不是单纯文本质量，而是过程忠实性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。优先看 benchmark 定义、operator taxonomy、五个评测轨道和三个指标。实验部分重点看 order-sensitive tracks，尤其是 order permutation、deferred filtering 和 few-shot/prompting 消融。若关注预训练数据 pipeline，可以重点读 Web Refinement、Privacy Redaction 和 RAG Preparation 的任务构造，因为这些更接近真实语料处理场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can directly and faithfully execute compositional, order-sensitive data refinement recipes, rather than only perform isolated text edits or rely on code and tool execution.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to pretraining data work because LLMs are increasingly used for corpus cleaning, filtering, PII redaction, RAG preparation, and format normalization. These operations are usually sequential, and intermediate states affect later steps. CDR-Bench isolates procedural faithfulness: whether a model applies the right operations in the right order, not whether the final text merely looks plausible.
summary_en.technical_approach: CDR-Bench formalizes refinement as an ordered sequence of operators applied to an evolving text state. Operators are divided into mappers, which rewrite text, and filters, which return KEEP or DROP. Given an input text and a natural-language recipe, the model must output both the execution status and the resulting text. References are produced by deterministic execution, enabling exact evaluation without an LLM judge. The benchmark contains 3,462 tasks across Web Refinement, LaTeX Refinement, RAG Preparation, and Privacy Redaction, with 29 operators and 63 recipe templates. It defines Atomic-M, Atomic-F, Agnostic-M, Order-M, and Order-F tracks, and uses Recipe Success, Order-Consistent Success, and Refinement Gain as complementary metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates more than ten strong LLMs. The main result is that good atomic-operator performance does not reliably transfer to compositional recipe execution. Models often produce plausible outputs while silently violating the prescribed order. On order-sensitive groups, fewer than 5% of Order-M groups and fewer than 19% of Order-F groups are solved correctly across all tested orderings. Filtering decisions are especially fragile: moving a filter from before a sequence of transformations to after it reduces exact recipe success by more than 47 percentage points. Prompt engineering and few-shot demonstrations do not remove the gap.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Read the benchmark definition, operator taxonomy, five tracks, and the three metrics first. In the experiments, focus on the order-sensitive tracks, order permutation analysis, deferred-filtering results, and prompting or few-shot ablations. For pretraining data pipeline design, the Web Refinement, Privacy Redaction, and RAG Preparation settings are the most useful parts.

recommendation.zh: 通义实验室出品的核心能力benchmark，暴露了LLM在顺序敏感组合任务上的致命缺陷，应加入内部基座评测集，重点看§4任务设计和§5结果
recommendation.en: Tongyi Lab benchmark exposing critical LLM failures in order-sensitive compositional tasks; add to internal base model evaluation suite, focus on §4 task design and §5 results

paper.title: Diff-Based Code Corruption using LLMs for Large-Scale Bugfix Benchmarking
paper.abstract: There are various benchmarks to evaluate bugfixing capabilities of Large Language Models. However, most widespread benchmarks do not fully reflect real-world bugfixing practices. They are small, weakening statistical reliability, and the buggy programs are often similar to one another, potentially distorting evaluation results. The range of bug types can also be narrow, failing to capture a representative range of bugs. To address these issues, we introduce MegaBugFix, a large-scale bugfixing be

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是代码修复评测集规模小、样本相似、bug 类型偏窄的问题，尤其是现有 LLM 合成 bug 容易生成语法错误或过于浅层的扰动，不能稳定衡量模型的真实修复能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更接近代码模型与代码智能体的评测资产。可取之处在于它把“用 LLM 生成坏样本”从直接改写代码改成生成 diff，并用人类提交中的 accepted/wrong-answer 对来训练 bug 注入器。这对构造代码训练数据、代码修复 SFT 数据和 verifier 数据有一定参考价值，但它不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一，从 Project CodeNet 中按同一用户、同一题目配对 accepted 提交和 wrong-answer 提交，并用 rapidfuzz 相似度过滤，只保留相似度至少 70% 的 correct/buggy 程序对，作为微调数据。第二，微调一个开源 LLM，让它从正确代码生成表示 bug 注入的 diff，而不是直接生成完整错误代码。这样做的动机是减少“输出与输入完全相同”的编辑失败，也减少直接改写时常见的语法级错误。第三，把训练好的 corruption model 应用于来自 6 个公开来源的正确 Python 程序，生成大规模 buggy variants，并统一不同来源的测试用例执行接口。
summary.experiments: 产物是 MegaBugFix，包含 12,629 个错误 Python 程序、对应正确版本和统一评测框架。论文指出，DebugBench 与 CodeEditorBench 中相当比例的 Python 样本不可解析，例如 DebugBench 的 832/1414，以及 CodeEditorBench Primary 的 312/716、Plus 的 193/356。MegaBugFix 的设计目标是减少这类语法错误，增加语义型 bug 和多样性。关键实验应主要看生成 bug 的可解析率、测试失败率、bug diff 规模分布，以及不同代码修复模型在该 benchmark 上的 pass@1/pass@k 表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造流程、CodeNet 配对规则、diff 生成微调设置、过滤与统一测试框架。若关注代码模型 post-training 数据，可以多看 bug diff 的分布和质量控制。若只关注 LLM 预训练，这篇的主要价值是数据合成范式，不需要细读模型评测排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness in bug-fixing evaluation: common benchmarks are small, structurally repetitive, and biased toward narrow or shallow bug types. Existing LLM-based corruption methods often create syntactic failures rather than realistic semantic bugs.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The main contribution is an evaluation and data-generation asset for code repair models. The useful idea is to train a corruption model on human accepted/wrong-answer pairs and make it emit diffs instead of full rewritten programs. This can inform synthetic data pipelines for code repair SFT, verifier training, or code-editing evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline starts from Project CodeNet. Accepted and wrong-answer Python submissions are paired by user and task, then filtered with a rapidfuzz similarity threshold of at least 70%. These correct/buggy pairs are used to fine-tune an open-weight LLM for code corruption. Instead of producing an entire buggy program, the model generates a diff. This choice reduces identity edits and makes the corruption operation explicit. The trained model is then applied to correct programs collected from six public sources, and their heterogeneous test suites are wrapped into a unified execution framework.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting benchmark, MegaBugFix, contains 12,629 buggy Python programs with correct counterparts and executable tests. The paper contrasts this with prior synthetic bug datasets where many Python samples are not parseable, such as 832/1414 in DebugBench and 312/716 plus 193/356 in two CodeEditorBench splits. The most informative results are the parseability and validity checks of injected bugs, the distribution of diff sizes and bug types, and pass@1/pass@k repair performance of LLMs under the unified harness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction pipeline, the CodeNet pairing rule, the diff-generation fine-tuning setup, and the filtering/evaluation harness. For code post-training data work, inspect the bug quality analysis. For pretraining research, the benchmark leaderboard is less important than the corruption-data recipe.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据构造和模型排名差异；合成 bug 有偏，但能暴露小型修复集对代码模型的乐观估计。
recommendation.en: Skim the data construction and ranking shifts; synthetic bugs are biased, but the benchmark usefully exposes optimism in small bug-fix sets.

paper.title: Speculative Refinement: A Hybrid Autoregressive Diffusion Decoding Strategy and Its Behavior Across Benchmarks
paper.abstract: How should we evaluate generation systems that combine autoregressive (AR) and diffusion decoding? We study this question through Speculative Refinement (SpecRef), a training-free hybrid method that warm-starts a masked diffusion language model from an AR draft using entropy-guided selective masking. Evaluating SpecRef across six benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, BBH, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag) with three distinct evaluation protocols (execution-based pass@1, exact-match, log-likelihood scoring

summary.core_problem: 探索自回归（AR）与掩码扩散语言模型的混合解码策略，并解决这类混合生成系统的评测标准缺失问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新（训练无关的混合AR-扩散解码范式）+ 原理分析（揭示现有主流基准的三大系统性偏差），为非AR语言建模与评测设计提供反常识参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Speculative Refinement（SpecRef）方法，无需额外训练：用AR模型生成初始草稿，基于熵引导的选择性掩码保留高置信token，将低置信区域输入掩码扩散LM做局部精修。
summary.experiments: 跨HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、BBH等6个主流基准，采用执行准确率、精确匹配、对数似然三种评测协议；发现语法支架可将代码基准准确率从近0提升至20%+，多阶段精修存在1.5%-3%的正确token退化率，对数似然与实际生成质量相关系数低于0.3。

summary_en.core_problem: Explore hybrid decoding strategies for autoregressive (AR) and masked diffusion language models, and address the lack of evaluation standards for such hybrid generation systems.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation (training-free hybrid AR-diffusion decoding paradigm) + principle analysis (revealing three systematic biases in mainstream benchmarks), providing counterintuitive references for non-autoregressive LM and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Speculative Refinement (SpecRef), a training-free method: generating an initial draft with an AR model, retaining high-confidence tokens via entropy-guided selective masking, and sending low-confidence regions to a masked diffusion LM for local refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 6 mainstream benchmarks including HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K and BBH with three protocols (execution accuracy, exact match, log-likelihood scoring); finds syntactic scaffolds lift code benchmark accuracy from ~0 to 20%+, multi-stage refinement corrupts 1.5-3% correct tokens, and log-likelihood has <0.3 correlation with actual generation quality.

recommendation.zh: 做非AR文本建模或LLM评测的优先看§4的三个发现，SpecRef方法本身是训练无关的弱创新，可跳过实现细节。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on non-autoregressive LMs or LLM evaluation should prioritize Section 4’s three findings; the SpecRef method itself is a minor training-free innovation, implementation details can be skipped.

paper.title: Triadic Werewolf: A Jester Role for Multi-Hop Theory of Mind in LLMs
paper.abstract: Theory-of-mind evaluations of large language models typically use dyadic social-deduction games, where every observable cue points to a single hidden side, so a model with strong language priors can score well without ever simulating opponents' incentives. We extend the Werewolf game with a Jester, a third faction whose utility on peer suspicion is inverted because it wins by being voted out, so optimal play requires reasoning across three opposing utility functions. Across 60 games on GPT-4.1,

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在三方利益结构下是否真正进行多跳 Theory of Mind 推理，而不是依赖二元阵营游戏中的语言先验。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测设计与行为分析。论文在 Werewolf 中加入 Jester 第三方角色，其目标是被投票出局，从而让“看起来可疑”与“阵营归属”不再单调对应。
summary.technical_approach: 构造 Triadic Werewolf：Villagers、Werewolves、Jester 三类 utility 同时存在。Jester 的收益函数反转，赢法是吸引怀疑并被投出。论文比较开启和关闭 Jester self-learning 时，不同模型在投票、伪装和策略调整上的表现。
summary.experiments: 共运行 60 局，模型包括 GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-V3.1、Llama-3.3-70B。Jester 获胜率为 60-70%，Werewolves 从未超过 20%；GPT-4.1 狼人在第 1 天把 Jester 投出的比例为 60-70%，属于自损行为。Self-learning 帮助 DeepSeek 和 Llama，但伤害 GPT-4.1；只有 DeepSeek 学到“显得可疑但不能显得刻意可疑”的策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can perform multi-hop theory-of-mind reasoning under three conflicting utility functions rather than relying on dyadic social-deduction priors.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and behavioral-analysis contribution. By adding a Jester role to Werewolf, suspicion no longer maps monotonically to an enemy side, making shallow language priors less reliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: Triadic Werewolf introduces Villagers, Werewolves, and a Jester. The Jester has an inverted utility: it wins by being voted out. The paper compares model behavior with and without Jester self-learning, focusing on voting, deception, and adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The study runs 60 games with GPT-4.1, DeepSeek-V3.1, and Llama-3.3-70B. Jesters win 60-70% of games, while Werewolves never exceed 20%. GPT-4.1 Werewolves vote out the Jester on day 1 in 60-70% of games, a self-defeating move. Self-learning helps DeepSeek and Llama but hurts GPT-4.1, and only DeepSeek learns the subtle suspicious-but-not-intentionally-suspicious strategy.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计有意思，但 60 局游戏太薄；看结果表即可，把它当 ToM 失败模式样本，不当能力结论。
recommendation.en: The evaluation design is interesting, but 60 games are thin evidence; read the result table as a ToM failure-mode sample, not as a capability ranking.

paper.title: Know2Guess: A Contamination-Aware Multi-Zone Benchmark for Knowledge-Boundary Evaluation in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reliable evaluation of large language models should separate supported answering from unsupported guessing without conflating either with data contamination, prompt idiosyncrasy, or generic refusal behavior. We present a contamination-aware, multi-zone benchmark for measuring the transition from answerable knowledge to abstention-expected unknowns under frozen build-time labels. The benchmark contains 1,200 items across five domains, explicit abstention expectations, contamination-risk metadata,

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要评测模型在“知道”和“应该放弃回答”之间的边界，而不是只看答题准确率。它重点处理三个容易混在一起的问题：模型是否真的知道答案，题目是否可能被训练数据污染，模型的不回答是基于知识不确定性，还是普通的安全拒答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在评测侧。Know2Guess 提供了一个较干净的协议，用来观察模型在知识边界附近的选择性回答能力。它对数据污染给出显式元数据，而不是简单假设 benchmark 未泄漏；它也把 productive abstention 和 policy refusal 分开统计。这对持续预训练、知识更新、数据去重、污染检测后的模型评估有用。贡献量级偏评测资产和诊断协议，不是训练方法本身；规模只有 1,200 题，适合做边界行为探针，不适合作为通用能力排行榜。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 按 frozen build-time label 构造四个 zone。A–C 是应答区，来自 CommonsenseQA、TriviaQA、MedMCQA、HotpotQA、SciQ 等真实公开题源，但按答案流行度和边界难度区分；D 是应当 abstain 的区域，由风格匹配的 synthetic unknown 构成。每个样本带问题、gold answer set、评分规则、zone、是否期望 abstention、来源、污染风险标签和审阅记录。评测协议使用固定 answer-or-abstain prompt，同时设置 answer-only control 和 prompt-template variants。解析器有两套：official strict parser 用于主结果，normalized robustness parser 用于检查格式和归一化敏感性。主指标 reliability 同时奖励 A–C 上正确回答和 D 上正确放弃；辅助指标包括 answered accuracy、abstention rate、Zone-D productive abstention、refusal rate、answered-item ECE，以及 boundary sharpness。这个设计的关键取舍是把“知识性放弃”和“政策性拒答”拆开，否则模型可以靠泛化拒答获得虚高分。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 FLAN-T5、Qwen2.5-Instruct 和 Llama-3-Instruct 系列。主结论是：更强的 instruction-tuned 模型会出现一定的选择性转移，但远没有解决知识边界问题。Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 在 answer-or-abstain 协议下 reliability 最高，为 0.3657，Zone-D productive abstention 达到 0.9249。Llama-3-8B-Instruct 在 A–C 的公开可答题上更准，但在未知题上选择性更差。answer-only control 下，两个 Qwen checkpoint 的表现明显下降，Llama 也有实质退化，说明固定的答题/放弃格式对测量边界行为很关键。parser normalization、prompt variants 和 cost-sensitive scoring 没有改变主要排序。负面结果同样重要：A–C 仍然难，answered-item ECE 偏高，benign-item refusal 仍是可见失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20–30 分钟即可。优先看 Introduction 中对 contamination、abstention、refusal 的拆分；Problem Formulation 里的 reliability、ECE、boundary sharpness 定义；Methodology 里 zone A–D 的构造和污染风险标注；实验部分重点看 answer-or-abstain 与 answer-only control 的对照，以及 strict parser 与 normalized parser 的稳定性分析。若要把它用于预训练或持续预训练评估，最值得深挖的是 Zone D 的 synthetic unknown 构造质量、污染风险标签的判定规则，以及 reliability 是否需要按业务风险重新加权。

summary_en.core_problem: The work evaluates whether a model can separate answerable knowledge from cases where it should abstain. The key issue is not raw accuracy alone, but the interaction among supported answering, data contamination, epistemic abstention, and policy-style refusal.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is as an evaluation and diagnostic asset. Know2Guess gives a fixed protocol for probing knowledge-boundary behavior while exposing contamination-risk metadata instead of assuming the benchmark is clean. It also reports productive abstention separately from generic refusal. This is useful for continual pretraining, knowledge-refresh evaluation, contamination audits, and measuring whether post-training improves selective answering. The contribution is an evaluation protocol rather than a training method. With 1,200 items, it is better suited as a targeted probe than as a broad capability leaderboard.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark partitions items into frozen zones. Zones A–C are answer-expected real-public questions, sourced from CommonsenseQA, TriviaQA, MedMCQA, HotpotQA, and SciQ, with different levels of answer popularity and boundary difficulty. Zone D is abstention-expected and built from style-matched synthetic unknowns. Each item includes a question, gold answer set, grading rule, zone label, abstention expectation, origin, contamination-risk tag, provenance, and review notes. Evaluation uses a locked answer-or-abstain prompt, answer-only controls, and prompt-template variants. Outputs are parsed with an official strict parser and a normalized robustness parser. The primary metric, reliability, gives credit for correct answers on answer-expected items and correct abstention on unknowns. Auxiliary reports include answered accuracy, abstention rate, productive abstention on Zone D, refusal rate, expected calibration error on answered items, and boundary sharpness. The important design choice is to avoid rewarding generic non-answer behavior as if it were calibrated epistemic caution.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates FLAN-T5, Qwen2.5-Instruct, and Llama-3-Instruct models. The main result is that stronger instruction-tuned models show some selective transition from answering to abstaining, but the behavior remains weak. Under the answer-or-abstain protocol, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct obtains the best reliability at 0.3657, with Zone-D productive abstention of 0.9249. Llama-3-8B-Instruct is more accurate on answerable public items, but is less selective on unknowns. Under answer-only controls, both Qwen checkpoints degrade sharply and Llama also drops materially. Parser normalization, prompt variants, and cost-sensitive scoring preserve the main rankings and qualitative conclusions. Remaining failures are clear: Zones A–C are still difficult, ECE on answered items stays high, and benign-item refusal is not negligible.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the introduction for the distinction among contamination, abstention, and refusal. Then inspect the task formulation for reliability, ECE, and boundary sharpness. In the methodology, focus on how Zones A–D are built and how contamination risk is assigned. In the experiments, prioritize the answer-or-abstain versus answer-only comparison, plus the strict-parser and normalized-parser robustness checks. For pretraining-oriented use, the parts worth checking carefully are the construction quality of synthetic unknowns, the contamination-risk annotation process, and whether reliability should be reweighted for different deployment costs.

recommendation.zh: 可看协议设计和污染标签；小规模基准别过度外推，但对评估“会不会承认不知道”有实用参考。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and contamination labels; the benchmark is small, but the abstention setup is practically useful.

paper.title: DualEval: Joint Model-Item Calibration for Unified LLM Evaluation
paper.abstract: Current LLM evaluation relies on two complementary but often disconnected signals: static benchmarks with objective correctness labels and arena-style preference data that better reflect open-ended user interactions. We introduce DualEval, a latent model-item calibration framework that represents models and evaluation items in a shared space, jointly estimating model ability together with item difficulty and sharpness. We apply DualEval across four domains: coding, math, miscellaneous domain-kno

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个评测建模问题：如何把“静态 benchmark 的对错标签”和“开放式 arena 的偏好信号”放到同一个可解释的统计框架里，同时不只给出模型总分，还能判断每一道题到底有多难、区分度有多高、哪些题已经饱和、哪些题最能拉开模型差距。现有做法通常把两类信号分开处理：benchmark 用准确率，arena 用 Bradley–Terry 或 Elo 一类偏好排序。这样做的问题是，二者刻画的是同一批模型能力的不同切面，却没有共享参数；而且大多数评测只聚焦模型分数，忽略 item-level 结构，导致高成本评测里混入大量低信息量题目，也难以发现污染、异常样本或奖励模型噪声。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于“怎样更稳地比较模型、比较训练配方、比较数据策略”。如果评测信号本身不稳定，pretrain 里的很多结论都会变得脆弱。DualEval 的贡献主要有三层。第一，它把静态正确率和开放式偏好统一到共享 latent ability scale 上，让两类信号共同约束模型能力参数，减少单一评测源的偏差。第二，它显式建模 item difficulty 和 sharpness，相当于把“题目是否有区分度”纳入评测对象，这对构造高信息密度 benchmark、做低成本子集评测、分析 benchmark 饱和都很有用。第三，它提供了 residual-based anomaly detection 和 Fisher-information-based subset selection，这两点对大模型迭代中的 benchmark 维护、污染检测、评测预算压缩都有现实价值。贡献量级属于评测方法上的扎实推进，不是范式级变化，但对日常模型开发和训练决策有实际帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个联合的 model-item calibration 框架，明显借鉴了 IRT，但做了适配。每个模型有一个 ability 参数 θ_i，每个题目有 difficulty b_q 和 sharpness a_q。对静态 benchmark，作者使用标准的 two-parameter logistic IRT：模型在题 q 上答对的概率由 sigmoid(a_q(θ_i-b_q)) 给出。这样 difficulty 控制题目门槛，sharpness 控制题目对能力差异的敏感度。与只看准确率不同，这里题目不是等权的；高 sharpness、能力阈值落在当前模型群附近的题，信息量更高。

开放式 arena 部分是这篇工作的关键。作者没有直接做人类两两偏好建模，而是先用 reward model 给每个模型在每个 prompt 上的回答打一个标量分数，再把这些分数标准化，构造成 soft pairwise preference target。然后，这个偏好目标不是单独用 Bradley–Terry 拟合，而是仍然通过共享的 θ_i、b_q、a_q 来解释。也就是说，同一个 prompt/item 在静态标签和开放式偏好里都对应同一套 item 参数，模型能力参数也共享。这样静态标签提供更干净的锚点，arena 偏好提供更贴近真实交互的开放式信号，两者共同更新 latent scale。

从全文看，作者比较强调 sharpness 而不是只建 difficulty，这一点是合理的。因为在 frontier model pool 里，很多题不是“难不难”的问题，而是“能不能区分相近模型”的问题。sharpness 高的题，在能力轴上斜率更大，更适合做排序。作者还把 Fisher information 作为 item 价值的度量，用来做 benchmark compression；同时利用观测结果与模型预测之间的 residual 做异常检测，识别被污染或不符合整体能力结构的 model-item 对。

方法上的取舍也很清楚：他们没有试图把所有偏好噪声、judge bias、annotator heterogeneity 都显式建模，而是先用 reward model 把开放式输出压成标量，再做联合校准。这让框架更简单，也更容易扩展到多域评测，但代价是结果会部分依赖 reward model 质量。作者因此专门做了 reward model 替换鲁棒性实验，并在 static-anchored 域里说明联合建模能缓解 RM 噪声。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 18 个 frontier LLM，分四个域：coding、math、miscellaneous domain knowledge，以及 generic everyday user queries。前三个域同时有静态 benchmark 标签和 arena 风格开放式回答；generic 域只有 arena 信号。开放式部分默认使用 LM Arena 内部的 scalar reward model，并用公开的 Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B 做鲁棒性验证。

结果上，DualEval 在三个 static-anchored 域对静态标签的重建准确率达到 88%–92%，对 arena 比较中的 decisive pairs 一致率达到 68%–81%。这些数字说明联合模型并不是只在 latent space 里给出一个好看的排序，而是能同时解释两类观测。更关键的是排序层面：相较 static-only 和 arena-only 基线，DualEval 给出的模型排名更平衡，不会被某一类信号单独主导。全文的重点不是追求某个 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是证明联合估计后的 ranking 在 bootstrap 下更稳定、在 reward model 替换后更稳健。

诊断实验是这篇文章最有信息量的部分。作者按 Fisher information 选取信息量最高的 10% 题目，在所有 static-anchored 域都能恢复全量数据排名，Spearman ρ≥0.95。这意味着大量评测题目对当前模型池几乎不提供额外排序信息，压缩 benchmark 是可行的。异常检测方面，在 clean-fit reference 下，基于 residual 的方法对注入污染的 static-label target 达到 AUROC≥0.995，对 arena-reward target 达到 0.93–0.98。这个结果说明联合模型学到的不是纯粹的经验拟合，而是形成了较稳定的 model-item expectation，偏离这个结构的样本可以被识别出来。

从局限看，generic everyday queries 域没有静态锚点，因此联合建模的优势会更依赖 reward model 本身；另外，18 个模型的规模对 IRT 拟合已足够做展示，但若模型池更大、能力分布更密集，sharpness 和 difficulty 的估计稳定性还需要更多验证。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 的建模定义，抓住三件事：共享的 model ability、共享的 item difficulty/sharpness、以及 arena 偏好如何被转成 soft pairwise target 并接入同一 latent scale。然后重点看实验里三类结果：一是 static-only / arena-only / joint 的 ranking 对比；二是 Fisher-information benchmark compression；三是 residual anomaly detection。这三部分分别对应“统一评测是否更稳”“item 参数是否真的有用”“联合模型是否有诊断价值”。

如果时间有限，优先看方法公式、主结果表、以及 item diagnostics 相关图表，30–40 分钟可以把主要思想读清。若想深一点，建议留意附录里 reward model 替换实验和 bootstrap 稳定性分析，这两处决定了方法是否只是依赖某个特定 judge。阅读时要带着一个问题：这个 latent calibration 框架能否迁移到 pretrain recipe ablation、data mixture 比较、mid-training checkpoint 追踪等更贴近训练研究的场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation modeling problem: how to place static benchmark correctness and open-ended arena preference signals into one shared, interpretable calibration framework, while also modeling item-level structure rather than only producing model-level scores. In current practice, benchmark accuracy and arena-style preference rankings are usually handled separately. That separation wastes signal because both are noisy views of the same underlying model capability. It also treats all items as equally informative, even though many questions are already saturated or provide little separation among frontier models.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is indirect but real. Pretraining decisions are only as reliable as the evaluation stack used to compare data mixtures, recipes, checkpoints, and model variants. DualEval contributes a more structured way to estimate model ability by jointly fitting benchmark and preference data, and it turns evaluation items into first-class objects through difficulty and sharpness parameters. That matters for benchmark maintenance, low-cost subset construction, contamination detection, and understanding when a benchmark has stopped being discriminative. This is not a new training paradigm, but it is a useful evaluation-method contribution with practical implications for model development.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a joint model-item calibration framework inspired by Item Response Theory. Each model i has an ability parameter theta_i. Each item q has a difficulty parameter b_q and a sharpness parameter a_q, with a_q parameterized to stay positive. For static benchmarks, the paper uses a standard 2PL IRT likelihood: the probability that model i solves item q is sigmoid(a_q(theta_i - b_q)). Difficulty captures where the item sits on the ability axis, while sharpness captures how strongly the item separates nearby models.

The more novel part is how open-ended arena data is integrated. Instead of directly fitting human pairwise preferences with a separate Bradley-Terry model, the authors first score each model response with a scalar reward model, standardize those scores, and construct soft pairwise preference targets. These targets are then fit through the same shared latent ability-difficulty-sharpness structure. In other words, benchmark labels and arena preferences both update the same model abilities and item parameters. Static labels act as cleaner anchors; arena data contributes broader, more realistic interaction signal.

A key design choice is to model item sharpness explicitly rather than only item difficulty. For frontier models, the central question is often not whether an item is hard in absolute terms, but whether it is discriminative for the current model pool. The paper then uses Fisher information derived from the fitted item parameters to identify high-signal subsets, and uses residuals between observed outcomes and model predictions for anomaly detection. This gives the framework a diagnostic role beyond ranking.

The main limitation of the approach is also clear from the full paper: open-ended supervision is compressed through a reward model, so the quality of the latent fit depends partly on judge quality. The authors address this with reward-model substitution experiments and show that static-anchored domains are more robust because benchmark labels regularize the shared latent scale.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 18 frontier LLMs across four domains: coding, math, miscellaneous domain knowledge, and generic everyday user queries. The first three domains include both static benchmark labels and arena-style open-ended responses; the generic domain uses arena data only. The default open-ended scorer is an internal LM Arena scalar reward model, with robustness checks using the public Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B reward model.

On reconstruction metrics, DualEval achieves 88% to 92% accuracy on static labels in the three static-anchored domains, and 68% to 81% agreement on decisive arena pairs. More important than raw reconstruction is the ranking behavior: compared with static-only and arena-only baselines, the joint model yields rankings that are more balanced across evaluation sources and more stable under bootstrap resampling. The paper is less about maximizing a single benchmark score and more about showing that a shared latent calibration produces rankings that are less brittle.

The strongest empirical section is the diagnostic analysis. Selecting only the top 10% of items by Fisher information recovers the full-data ranking with Spearman rho at least 0.95 in all static-anchored domains. That is a strong sign that many items contribute little marginal ranking signal for the current model pool. For anomaly detection, residual-based methods recover injected contamination with AUROC at least 0.995 for static-label targets and 0.93 to 0.98 for arena-reward targets under a clean-fit reference. This suggests the model learns a meaningful model-item structure rather than merely overfitting aggregate outcomes.

A practical caveat is that the generic everyday-query domain lacks static anchors, so robustness there depends more heavily on reward-model quality. Also, 18 models are enough to demonstrate the method, but larger and denser model pools would be useful to further test the stability of difficulty and sharpness estimates.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and method to lock in three ideas: shared model ability, shared item difficulty and sharpness, and the way arena preferences are converted into soft pairwise targets inside the same latent scale. Then focus on three experimental blocks: joint versus static-only versus arena-only rankings, Fisher-information-based benchmark compression, and residual-based anomaly detection. Those correspond to the three practical claims of the paper.

If time is limited, the core method equations, the main ranking tables, and the item-diagnostics figures are enough to understand the contribution in about 30 to 40 minutes. If reading more carefully, pay attention to the reward-model substitution results and the bootstrap stability analysis in the appendix. Those sections determine whether the framework is genuinely robust or just tuned to one judge. A useful question to keep in mind is whether this calibration setup could be reused for comparing pretraining recipes, data mixtures, or checkpoint trajectories rather than only public-facing model evaluation.
