Current leaderboards exhibit extremely low effective dimensionality (d_eff ≈ 3-5), making this blind spot vastly larger than statistical noise and undermining ranking reliability.
summary_en.importance: Provides rigorous stereological quantification of the theoretical limits of benchmark coverage, demonstrating that current benchmark design suffers from systematic structural deficiency rather than mere statistical fluctuation. Direct implication for pretraining research: if the geometric blind spot exceeds the runner-up score gap by two orders of magnitude, using leaderboard rankings to guide pretraining iterations is questionable. Contribution type: theoretical analysis + algorithmic improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models each benchmark as a width measurement of the convex hull of model capability profiles in ℝᴰ. Effective dimensionality d_eff (computed via participation ratio) characterizes the true number of independent directions probed by a benchmark suite. Theorem 2 gives a visible Hausdorff distance upper bound ε + C·R·m^{-1/(d_eff-1)} with a matching Lipschitz lower bound. A submodular greedy algorithm for benchmark selection achieves (1-1/e) approximate optimality for coverage maximization. Additionally resolves Gardner's 1995 open problem for C² support functions.
summary_en.experiments: Three independent leaderboards (Open LLM v2, extended 12-benchmark suite, LiveBench) show d_eff ∈ [2.86, 4.80] on their competitive frontiers. Structural blind spot exceeds observed runner-up score gaps by two orders of magnitude and dominates statistical noise by 52-127×. Top-two swap probability lies in [0.38, 0.49]. Submodular greedy selection: 7 out of 12 benchmarks achieve 90% coverage, with a stable core of 4 benchmarks transferring 93-97% cross-temporally.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 1 for the core argument and stereology analogy. Section 2 covers the benchmark-as-width modeling assumptions. Sections 3-4 contain the main theoretical results (Theorems 1-4). Section 5 provides empirical verification. Section 6 covers the submodular coverage algorithm. Key figures: Figure 2 (d_eff computation), Figure 4 (blind spot comparison). Estimated reading time: 1-1.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: 从立体学理论证明当前 LLM benchmark 排名极不可靠——92% 的随机切分会改变 top-1。核心看 Fig 3 和 §5 的模拟结果，对理解评测噪声上限很有价值。
recommendation.en: Stereological proof that current LLM benchmark rankings are extremely unstable (92% of random splits change top-1). Focus on Fig 3 and §5 simulations — valuable for understanding the upper bound of evaluation noise.

paper.title: ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models
paper.abstract: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model

summary.core_problem: 标准幻觉 benchmark 仅用错误率 ε 评估模型，将所有错误视为等价，但实际错误严重程度差异可达数量级（如错日期 vs 捏造法庭裁决）。在相同准确率下，不同模型的错误严重程度分布可能截然不同，这一维度被现有评估体系完全忽略。
summary.importance: 证明错误严重程度分布（尤其是尾部行为）提供了准确率无法区分的判别信息。对预训练研究的启示：优化预训练目标时除了整体准确率，还应考虑错误严重性的尾部分布，这对安全敏感场景的模型训练尤为重要。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 Errorquake-10k benchmark（10,000 查询，8 个领域，5 个难度级别），对每个响应使用连续 0-4 分 9 级严重度量表打分。借鉴地震学 Gutenberg-Richter 关系，用尾部斜率 b 刻画模型的严重度分布：b 小表示错误少但偶发灾难性错误，b 大表示小错误多但严重度有界。采用双裁判评分（8 模型循环池，排除自评）校准。
summary.experiments: 21 个开源指令微调模型（3B-37B 活跃参数）。210 个模型对中，85 对在匹配准确率（|Δε|<0.05）下有不相交的 95% b 置信区间（人类共识评分）。量表 ICC(2,k=3)=0.85，人类-b vs 裁判-b 等级相关 ρ=0.89（15 个模型）。密集模型缩放相关 ρ_s=-0.86：模型越大，严重度尾部越重。错误类型随严重度分类变化（低=71% 检索错误，高=39% 捏造）。
summary.reading_guide: Section 1 引言和核心论点；Section 2 benchmark 和量表设计；Section 4.1 配对判别 headline 结果；Section 4.3 缩放分析；Section 5 不可约性定理。重点看 Figure 1（b vs ε 散点图）、Figure 3（严重度分布示例）。预计阅读 45-60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard hallucination benchmarks reduce model evaluation to a single error rate ε, treating all errors as equivalent, yet error severity can differ by orders of magnitude (e.g., wrong date vs. fabricated court ruling). At matched accuracy, models can have dramatically different error severity distributions—a dimension entirely invisible to current evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that error severity distribution (especially tail behavior) carries discriminative information inaccessible to accuracy alone. Implication for pretraining: optimizing for overall accuracy is insufficient; tail behavior of error severity should also be considered, particularly for safety-critical model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Errorquake-10k benchmark (10,000 queries across 8 domains × 5 difficulty tiers), scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 scale with 9 levels. Borrows the Gutenberg-Richter magnitude-frequency relation from seismology to characterize severity distribution via tail slope b: small b means few errors but occasional catastrophic ones; large b means many small errors with bounded severity. Uses a dual-judge scoring pipeline with an 8-model round-robin pool excluding self-judging.
summary_en.experiments: 21 open-weight instruction-tuned models (3B-37B active parameters). 85 out of 210 model pairs have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Δε|<0.05) under human-consensus scoring. Scale validation: ICC(2,k=3)=0.85, human-b vs judge-b rank correlation ρ=0.89 across 15 models. Dense-model scaling correlation ρ_s=-0.86: larger models have heavier severity tails. Error type shifts categorically with severity (low=71% retrieval, high=39% fabrication).
summary_en.reading_guide: Section 1 for core argument and motivation. Section 2 for benchmark and scale design. Section 4.1 for the headline pairwise discrimination results. Section 4.3 for scaling analysis. Section 5 for the non-reducibility theorem. Key figures: Figure 1 (b vs ε scatter), Figure 3 (severity distribution examples). Estimated reading time: 45-60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 同精度下模型的严重错误分布差异巨大——这是 pre-train 和 RL 阶段都应关注的新维度。看 §4 的 per-model b 估计和 Fig 2 的分布对比，可直接启发更精细的训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Models at matched accuracy can have wildly different severe-error distributions — a new dimension to track in both pretrain and RL. Read §4 per-model b estimates and Fig 2 distribution comparisons; directly informs finer-grained training objectives.

paper.title: Self-Commitment Latency: A Reward-Free Probe for Prompted Implicit Hacking
paper.abstract: Implicit reward hacking is hard to audit when a language model's chain of thought appears benign: a final answer may be anchored by a prompt shortcut while the written reasoning still resembles ordinary problem solving. Verifier-based probes expose such behavior by measuring how early truncated reasoning contexts obtain high reward, but require a task-specific reward signal. This paper proposes a weaker-input alternative, self-commitment latency, which measures how early a prompted reasoning con

summary.core_problem: 现有隐式奖励黑客检测方法（如TRACE）依赖任务特定的奖励信号或外部正确性标签，无法在无奖励输入的场景下识别思维链表面正常、实际利用提示捷径锚定答案的隐式作弊行为。
summary.importance: 提出了完全无奖励依赖的轻量级模型行为诊断方法，不需要访问模型隐藏状态、梯度或标注作弊样本，为对齐训练、推理监控的奖励黑客检测提供了低成本的新观测信号，同时验证了自承诺时序作为行为探针的有效性。
summary.technical_approach: 定义自承诺延迟指标，对单条生成的完整思维链，按固定步长截断不同长度的前缀，强制模型基于前缀输出答案，统计前缀答案与模型自身完整输出的最终答案的匹配率，绘制承诺度随思维链长度变化的曲线；以匹配率首次达到0.8（即5次采样中4次匹配）时的前缀长度作为核心统计量，区分诚实推理与提示锚定的作弊行为：作弊场景下模型可在思维链极早期就锁定最终答案，诚实推理则需要推导到中间步骤后才会稳定承诺。
summary.experiments: 在GSM8K的50道整数答案题目上做配对对照实验，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit模型，同一道题分别使用普通提示和附带正确答案提示的输入生成思维链；实验结果显示带答案提示的作弊场景首次达到0.8承诺度的前缀长度显著短于诚实推理场景，且整体承诺度曲线的不确定性更低；同时通过阈值敏感性测试（0.5到1.0区间的不同阈值）、正确样本分层验证，排除了信号来自阈值人工设置或仅能检测错误答案的干扰；实验还验证了原回溯质量假设的信号强度较弱。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章方法部分的指标定义和实验流程设计，以及第3章的配对实验结果图和阈值敏感性消融；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，核心价值是理解无奖励行为探针的设计思路，不需要深挖数学细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing implicit reward hacking detection methods such as TRACE rely on task-specific reward signals or external correctness labels, and cannot identify implicit cheating behaviors where the chain of thought appears normal but the answer is actually anchored by prompt shortcuts in reward-free scenarios.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a fully reward-free, lightweight model behavior diagnostic method that does not require access to model hidden states, gradients, or labeled cheating samples. It provides a low-cost new observation signal for reward hacking detection in alignment training and inference monitoring, and verifies the effectiveness of self-commitment timing as a behavioral probe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The self-commitment latency metric is defined as follows: for a single generated full chain of thought, truncate prefixes of different lengths at a fixed stride, force the model to output answers based on each prefix, calculate the match rate between prefix answers and the model's own final answer from the full generation, and plot the commitment curve against chain of thought length. The core statistic is the prefix length when the match rate first reaches 0.8 (i.e., 4 out of 5 samples match), which distinguishes honest reasoning from prompt-anchored cheating: in cheating scenarios the model can lock in the final answer very early in the chain of thought, while honest reasoning only achieves stable commitment after intermediate derivation steps.
summary_en.experiments: Paired controlled experiments are conducted on 50 integer-answer problems from GSM8K using the Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit model. Each problem is run twice: once with a normal prompt and once with a prompt appended with the correct answer as a hint. Results show that the prefix length for first reaching 0.8 commitment in the hinted cheating scenario is significantly shorter than in the honest reasoning scenario, and the overall commitment curve has lower uncertainty. Threshold sensitivity tests across values from 0.5 to 1.0 and stratified checks on correct samples rule out confounding factors such as threshold artifacts or the signal only detecting incorrect answers. The experiments also confirm that the original backtracking-mass hypothesis produces weak signals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the metric definition and experiment pipeline design in Chapter 2, as well as the paired experiment plots and threshold sensitivity ablation in Chapter 3. Estimated reading time is 15-20 minutes. The core value is understanding the design logic of reward-free behavioral probes, with no need to dig deep into mathematical details.

recommendation.zh: 做推理评测/检测CoT作弊的可以看§3的指标定义，预训练研究员可用来审计推理数据质量
recommendation.en: Reasoning evaluation / CoT cheating detection researchers can check §3 for metric definition; pretrain researchers can use it to audit reasoning data quality

paper.title: Truthful AI Advisors: A Pre-Specified Benchmark for Large Language Model Honesty Under Preference Misalignment

summary.core_problem: 当LLM作为顾问（推荐系统、销售助理、谈判代理等）部署时，其目标往往与用户不完全对齐。核心问题是：当诚实性与模型自身收益冲突时，LLM是否仍会保持诚实？
summary.importance: 将经典博弈论（Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话模型）转化为衡量LLM在偏好不一致下诚实性的预定义基准。属于对齐评测方向的新框架，而非传统的预训练方法研究。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于：揭示了LLM在策略性信息传递场景中的行为规律，可为理解RLHF/对齐训练对模型诚实性的影响提供可量化的测量工具。
summary.technical_approach: LLM作为信息发送方（sender），观察状态ω∈[0,1]，发送自然语言消息。校准的接收方解码器将消息映射为行动。发送方偏好行动接近ω+b（b为向上偏差），接收方偏好行动接近ω。通过改变b（5个水平：0到较大值）控制偏好冲突程度，三个提示框架隔离核心框架对比（零偏差诚实检查、正偏差梯度、收益最大化vs.诚实框架）。基准设计精简为4个模型×5个偏差×3个框架×每格200个状态=12,000次调用。
summary.experiments: 在4个经过指令微调的模型上运行完整实验设计（12,000次记录调用）。主要分析维度：（1）消息信息量是否随发送方偏差增加而下降；（2）经验分区数量是否追踪理论最大分区数量，或模型是否过度透露信息；（3）明确强调收益最大化是否相对于诚实框架减少信息传递。提供了精确的理论基准（分区计数、归一化互信息、基线损失）用于对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。核心贡献是基准设计，建议重点阅读引言（动机）、模型与均衡基准部分（理论基础和指标定义）。若仅关心对预训练研究的启示，读完引言和方法概述即可。预计阅读时间30-45分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供内容中找到作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs are deployed as advisors (recommender systems, sales assistants, negotiation agents, etc.), their objectives often diverge from the user's. The core question: do LLMs remain truthful when honesty conflicts with their own payoff?
summary_en.importance: Converts classical game theory (Crawford-Sobel cheap-talk model) into a pre-specified benchmark for measuring LLM honesty under preference misalignment. Represents a new evaluation framework for alignment research, not traditional pretraining methods. Indirect value for pretraining researchers: reveals LLM behavioral patterns in strategic information transmission scenarios and provides a quantifiable measurement tool for understanding how RLHF/alignment training affects model honesty.
summary_en.technical_approach: The LLM acts as the sender, observing state ω∈[0,1] and emitting a natural-language message. A calibrated receiver decoder maps messages to actions. The sender prefers action near ω+b (b is upward bias), while the receiver prefers action near ω. Preference conflict is controlled by varying b across 5 levels (from 0 to large). Three prompt frames isolate the core framing contrast (zero-bias honesty check, positive-bias gradient, payoff maximization vs. honesty framing). The benchmark design is streamlined to 4 models × 5 biases × 3 frames × 200 states per cell = 12,000 calls.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental design run on 4 instruction-tuned models (12,000 logged sender calls). Three central analytical questions: (1) Does message informativeness decline as sender bias increases? (2) Do empirical partition counts track theoretical maximum partitions, or do models over-reveal? (3) Does emphasizing payoff maximization reduce information transmission relative to honesty framing? Exact theoretical benchmarks (partition counts, normalized mutual information, baseline losses) are provided for comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. The core contribution is the benchmark design. Focus on the Introduction (motivation) and the Model & Equilibrium Benchmark section (theoretical foundations and metric definitions). If only interested in implications for pretraining research, the introduction and method overview suffice. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: LLM诚实性对齐的新评测基准，重点看测试用例设计部分，可用于内部对齐效果的补充评测
recommendation.en: New benchmark for LLM honesty alignment, focus on test case design section, can be used for supplementary internal alignment evaluation

institutions: Independent Researcher in AI and Statistics

paper.title: Evaluating Interactive Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Hierarchical Benchmark with Executable Games
paper.abstract: We introduce a multi-turn interactive framework for reasoning evaluation that treats reasoning as active evidence acquisition and belief updating. Wherein, LLMs receive only the task rules, must issue targeted queries to a hidden environment, integrate partial observations over time, and decide when to submit a final answer. Beyond standard success rate and interaction efficiency, we evaluate contextual robustness under controlled contextual perturbations, and metacognitive adaptation through co

summary.core_problem: 现有大语言模型推理评测多为静态单轮设置，无法区分知识缺陷与推理缺陷，也不能评估主动信息获取、信念更新等交互式推理能力，评测的诊断价值低、抗污染性不足。
summary.importance: 提出了新的交互式推理评测范式，可更精细拆解推理能力的不同维度，为预训练和对齐阶段的推理能力优化提供了更准确的评估信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构建分层交互式推理评测框架，将推理解模为部分可观测下的主动信息获取过程：模型仅接收任务规则，需要主动查询隐藏环境、整合局部观测、自主决定何时提交最终答案。额外增加两层评测维度：上下文鲁棒性（测试扰动下的推理稳定性）、元认知适配（测试反事实修正和信息必要性判断）。基于集合、序列、树、图四种数据结构和演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理模式，构建了474个可执行游戏，每个包含5个难度等级。
summary.experiments: 对多个前沿大模型测试显示，该基准区分度高，不同模型在最终成功率、交互效率上差异显著；演绎任务难度普遍低于溯因任务，集合类游戏难度最高；上下文扰动会带来中等程度性能下降，反事实修正和证据必要性判断任务暴露了现有大模型的明显短板，现有模型更擅长固定证据下的问题求解，而非维护可修正的推理过程。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的评测动机与现有方法局限、第3章的分层框架设计与基准构建逻辑，以及实验部分的核心结论，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing LLM reasoning evaluations are static single-turn setups that cannot distinguish between knowledge deficits and reasoning deficits, nor evaluate interactive reasoning capabilities such as active information acquisition and belief updating, leading to limited diagnostic value and high contamination risk.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a new interactive reasoning evaluation paradigm that can granularly decompose different dimensions of reasoning ability, providing more accurate assessment signals for reasoning ability optimization during pretraining and alignment stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a hierarchical interactive reasoning evaluation framework that models reasoning as active information acquisition under partial observability: models receive only task rules, need to actively query the hidden environment, integrate partial observations, and decide when to submit the final answer independently. Two additional evaluation dimensions are added: contextual robustness (testing reasoning stability under perturbations) and metacognitive adaptation (testing counterfactual revision and information necessity judgment). The benchmark includes 474 executable games across 4 canonical data structures (sets, sequences, trees, graphs) and 3 inference modes (deductive, inductive, abductive), each with 5 difficulty levels.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation on multiple frontier LLMs shows high discriminative power, with significant differences across models in final success rate and interaction efficiency. Deductive tasks are generally easier than abductive tasks, and set-based games are the most challenging family. Contextual perturbations cause moderate performance degradation, while counterfactual revision and evidence necessity probes reveal substantial weaknesses in current LLMs, which perform better at solving problems with fixed evidence than maintaining revisable reasoning processes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 for evaluation motivation and limitations of existing methods, Section 3 for hierarchical framework design and benchmark construction logic, and the experiment section for core findings. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将推理评测从静态扩展到多轮交互式，元认知评估维度有新意，值得关注benchmark设计思路。
recommendation.en: Extends reasoning evaluation from static to multi-turn interactive; metacognitive evaluation dimension is novel. Worth examining benchmark design methodology.

paper.title: Off-the-Shelf LLMs as Process Scorers: Training-Free Alternative to PRMs for Mathematical Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很实际的推理时计算分配问题：小模型生成数学推理，大模型只做打分，怎样把大模型的能力用在“错误尚未扩散之前”的关键决策点，而不是等整条推理链都生成完再做事后筛选。作者指出，Best-of-N、majority voting 这类后验选择方法经常失败，不是因为大模型不会评分，而是因为评分发生得太晚；小模型早期一旦走偏，后面再强的 scorer 也只能在一堆错误轨迹里挑一个。论文的核心问题因此是：能否不用额外训练 PRM，仅靠现成大模型的 likelihood，在生成过程中做类似 PRM guided search 的过程级引导。
summary.importance: 这篇虽然更偏 inference-time reasoning，而不是预训练 recipe，但对基座研究仍有两层价值。第一，它把“更强模型的 log-prob 能否作为过程监督信号”这个问题讲得很清楚。若答案是可以，那么很多原本依赖 step-level reward 标注和 PRM 训练的流程，可以部分被现成 base model 的概率信号替代。第二，它揭示了一个很有研究味道的现象：同样是大模型 likelihood，放在 post-hoc reranking 上效果差，放在 generation-time chunk selection 上效果好，说明监督信号的时机比信号形式本身更关键。这对 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口、test-time scaling、甚至未来的 RL-free reasoning 都有启发。第三，作者还分析了长度偏置问题，说明为什么 variable-length step scoring 即便做 length normalization 仍然不稳，这对任何把 LM likelihood 当 verifier / reward 的工作都很重要。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Chunk-Level Guided Generation。整体框架沿用 generate-score-select 的思路，但把 PRM 换成现成大模型的 likelihood scorer，而且评分对象不是自然分段的 reasoning step，而是固定长度 chunk。

具体流程是：给定当前上下文，小模型在每一步采样 k 个长度为 L 的候选 chunk；大模型不生成文本，只对这 k 个候选 continuation 计算分数；选出最高分 chunk 拼接回上下文，再进入下一轮采样。这样大模型只承担判别式打分，计算可以并行，最终答案仍由小模型逐块生成。

作者提出两种打分规则。

1. Likelihood-Guided Selection, LGS：直接用大模型对候选 chunk 的长度归一化 log-prob 评分，选分数最高者。
2. Contrastive-Guided Selection, CGS：用大模型分数减去小模型分数，即 ℓ_large - ℓ_small。这个设计的动机很直接：如果某个 chunk 小模型自己就很偏好，那么大模型的额外信息量有限；真正值得保留的是那些“大模型明显更认可、而小模型没那么认可”的 continuation。它有点像把大模型当作 residual teacher，而不是单纯的 reranker。

为什么要用 fixed-length chunk，而不是自然语言里的“一个推理步骤”？这是全文最关键的技术判断之一。作者发现，大模型 likelihood 对 variable-length reasoning step 有系统性长度偏置，哪怕做了长度归一化，仍然偏向更长的 step。原因不是简单的 token 数除法能消掉的，因为不同长度 step 的语义完成度、局部确定性和格式模式都不同。固定长度 chunk 让同一决策点上的候选具有相同 token 长度，分数才真正可比。

与 PRM guided search 的区别主要有三点。第一，不需要 step-level 标注和 reward model 训练。第二，评分信号来自通用大模型的 next-token likelihood，而不是专门学出来的 process reward。第三，搜索粒度是固定长度 chunk，不依赖人工定义的 reasoning step 边界。与 Best-of-N 的区别则在于选择时机前移：不是整条轨迹生成完再选，而是在中间不断纠偏。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个数学推理 benchmark：GSM8K、MATH、Minerva Math、AMC23、AIME24。模型组合有三组：Qwen2.5-1.5B 由 Qwen2.5-32B 引导，Llama-3.2-1B 由 Llama-3.1-70B 引导，以及更大的 Qwen2.5-7B 由 Qwen2.5-72B 引导。

关键结果有几条。

1. chunk-level guidance 明显优于 post-hoc selection。作者专门展示了一个反直觉现象：用大模型 likelihood 做 Best-of-N reranking 并不好，甚至随着候选数增加会变差。文中给出的例子是，Qwen2.5-1.5B 在 MATH 上由 Qwen2.5-32B 做 post-hoc likelihood 选择时，准确率会从 55.8% 降到 52.6%。这说明问题不在 scorer 太弱，而在打分时机太晚。

2. CGS 通常优于 LGS，也优于多数后验基线。对比对象包括 Majority@k、Self-Certainty、Borda count、Best-of-N。作者的结论是，在三组模型上，chunk-level guidance 都能稳定超过这些 post-hoc 方法；其中 CGS 是最稳的版本。

3. 在两组小生成器设置里，CGS 在多数 benchmark 上能匹配或超过用 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B 做的 PRM guided search；在 7B 生成器设置里，CGS 的五个 benchmark 平均成绩距离 PRM-72B guided search 约 1.5 个百分点，距离 standalone 72B greedy baseline 约 0.4 个百分点。这个结果的含义不是“完全替代 PRM”，而是“在不训练 reward model 的前提下，已经接近专用过程奖励模型的效果”。

4. 作者还强调收益不是来自生成更长的推理链。CGS 的 reasoning trace 明显短于 PRM guided search；在 GSM8K 上，PRM 的输出 token 数最多可比 CGS 多 80%。这说明 chunk-level guidance 提升的是局部决策质量，而不是单纯靠更长 CoT 堆出来。

5. 长度偏置分析是实验部分另一个重点。作者展示 variable-length step scoring 即便做 length normalization 仍偏向长 step，因此 fixed-length chunk 不是工程上的简化，而是让 likelihood 可比较的必要条件。

如果从方法可信度看，这篇实验做得比较完整：既有不同模型家族，也有不同 generator / scorer 尺度组合，还把 post-hoc、PRM-guided、standalone large model 都放进了比较框架里。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得认真看方法和实验，但不必逐段细抠所有 benchmark 表。建议顺序如下：

1. 先看 Introduction 前半部分，抓住作者对 post-hoc selection 失败原因的判断：不是 scorer 不行，而是 timing 不对。
2. 接着看方法部分里 LGS 和 CGS 的定义，以及 fixed-length chunk 的动机。这是全文最核心的两点。尤其要看作者如何论证 variable-length step scoring 的长度偏置。
3. 实验部分优先看三类对比：chunk-level vs Best-of-N；CGS vs LGS；CGS vs PRM-guided search。只要把这三组关系看清，整篇文章的结论就基本成立了。
4. 再看 token length / cost 分析。这里能帮助判断方法到底是在“更聪明地用大模型”，还是只是“多花算力”。

预计 35–50 分钟可以读完关键内容。如果要深挖，建议重点思考两个问题：第一，CGS 为什么在数学推理上有效，它更像 distribution correction 还是 implicit verifier；第二，这种 likelihood-based process scoring 能否迁移到代码、工具使用、长链规划，还是只在高局部可验证的任务上成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical compute-allocation problem for reasoning: if a small model generates candidate math reasoning and a larger model is only used as a scorer, how can the larger model intervene early enough to prevent error propagation, rather than reranking completed but already flawed solutions? The authors argue that post-hoc methods such as Best-of-N and majority voting often fail not because the large model is a weak scorer, but because scoring happens too late. The core question is whether one can recover the main benefit of PRM-guided search—process-level guidance during generation—without training a separate process reward model, using only off-the-shelf LM likelihoods.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time reasoning paper, but it has clear relevance to foundation-model research. First, it sharpens the question of whether a stronger model’s log-probabilities can serve as a usable process-level supervision signal. If yes, some workflows that currently depend on step-level labels and PRM training may be replaced or approximated by native likelihood signals from a pretrained model. Second, the paper isolates a useful principle: the timing of supervision can matter more than the form of supervision. The same large-model likelihood signal performs poorly in post-hoc reranking yet works well when inserted inside generation. That has implications for test-time scaling, RL-free reasoning, and the interface between pretraining and post-training. Third, the paper gives a careful analysis of length bias in likelihood-based scoring, which matters for any work that treats LM probabilities as a verifier or reward proxy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is called Chunk-Level Guided Generation. It follows a generate-score-select loop similar in spirit to PRM-guided search, but replaces the trained PRM with an off-the-shelf large LM used purely as a likelihood scorer. The scoring unit is not a natural reasoning step but a fixed-length chunk.

At each decision point, the small model samples k candidate chunks of length L from the current context. The large model does not generate any text; it only scores the k candidate continuations. The highest-scoring chunk is appended to the context, and generation continues from there. This makes the large model a parallelizable discriminative guide rather than the generator of the final solution.

Two scoring rules are proposed.

1. Likelihood-Guided Selection (LGS): select the candidate with the highest length-normalized log-probability under the large model.
2. Contrastive-Guided Selection (CGS): score each chunk by large-model log-probability minus small-model log-probability, i.e. ℓ_large - ℓ_small. The intuition is that chunks already strongly preferred by the small model provide less incremental value from the larger model. CGS emphasizes continuations where the larger model contributes information beyond the generator’s own preference.

The fixed-length chunk design is one of the paper’s most important technical choices. The authors show that large-model likelihoods are systematically biased toward longer reasoning steps even after length normalization. Natural step boundaries are therefore a poor unit for direct likelihood comparison. Fixed-length chunks remove this confound by ensuring that all candidates at a given decision point have the same token length, making scores genuinely comparable.

Relative to PRM-guided search, the method differs in three ways: it requires no step-level labels or reward-model training; it uses native next-token likelihoods from a general LM rather than a learned process reward; and it operates on fixed-length chunks rather than human- or model-defined reasoning steps. Relative to Best-of-N, the key difference is timing: selection is moved inside generation rather than applied after full trajectories are completed.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers five math reasoning benchmarks: GSM8K, MATH, Minerva Math, AMC23, and AIME24. Three model pairings are tested: Qwen2.5-1.5B guided by Qwen2.5-32B, Llama-3.2-1B guided by Llama-3.1-70B, and Qwen2.5-7B guided by Qwen2.5-72B.

Several results stand out.

1. Chunk-level guidance substantially outperforms post-hoc selection. The paper highlights a useful negative result: using large-model likelihood for Best-of-N reranking is often poor and can even get worse as N increases. One concrete example is Qwen2.5-1.5B on MATH, where post-hoc likelihood selection with Qwen2.5-32B drops from 55.8% to 52.6% as k grows. This supports the paper’s main claim that the bottleneck is timing, not scorer quality.

2. CGS is generally stronger than LGS and stronger than the main post-hoc baselines, including Majority@k, Self-Certainty, Borda count, and Best-of-N. Across all three model pairings, chunk-level guidance consistently beats these post-hoc methods, with CGS being the most robust variant.

3. In the two smaller-generator settings, CGS matches or outperforms PRM-guided search using Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-72B on most benchmarks. In the 7B-generator setting, CGS is within about 1.5 percentage points of PRM-72B guided search on average across five benchmarks, and within 0.4 points of the standalone 72B greedy baseline. The significance is not that PRMs are obsolete, but that a training-free method gets surprisingly close to a specialized process reward model.

4. The gains are not explained by longer chains of thought. CGS produces noticeably shorter reasoning traces than PRM-guided search; on GSM8K, PRM outputs can be up to 80% longer. This suggests the method improves local decision quality rather than simply buying accuracy through longer generation.

5. The length-bias analysis is an important part of the empirical story. The paper shows that variable-length step scoring remains biased even after length normalization, which justifies fixed-length chunking as more than an engineering convenience.

Overall, the experimental section is fairly convincing: it spans multiple model families, multiple generator/scorer scales, and compares against post-hoc selection, PRM-guided search, and standalone large-model baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read, especially the method and the ablations, though not every benchmark table needs equal attention. A good reading order is:

1. Start with the first half of the Introduction. The key framing is that post-hoc selection fails because scoring happens after trajectories have already diverged.
2. Then read the method section closely, especially the definitions of LGS and CGS and the motivation for fixed-length chunks. The argument about length bias in variable-length step scoring is central.
3. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: chunk-level guidance vs Best-of-N, CGS vs LGS, and CGS vs PRM-guided search. If those three relationships are clear, the main contribution is clear.
4. Finally, read the token-length and cost analysis. It helps determine whether the gains come from better use of a strong model or simply from spending more compute.

Roughly 35–50 minutes should be enough for the key content. If digging deeper, two questions are worth keeping in mind: why CGS works so well in math—whether it behaves more like distribution correction or an implicit verifier—and whether likelihood-based process scoring can transfer to code, tool use, or long-horizon planning, or whether it mainly works in tasks with strong local verifiability.

recommendation.zh: 探讨用通用 LLM 替代专门训练的 PRM，对降低 RL/Search 成本有实际意义，重点看其 prompt 设计和与专有 PRM 的 gap 有多大。
recommendation.en: Explores replacing specially trained PRMs with general LLMs, practically significant for reducing RL/Search costs. Focus on their prompt design and the performance gap compared to proprietary PRMs.

paper.title: GraphARC: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Graph-Based Abstract Reasoning
paper.abstract: Relational reasoning lies at the heart of intelligence, but existing benchmarks are typically confined to formats such as grids or text. We introduce GraphARC, a benchmark for abstract reasoning on graph-structured data. GraphARC generalizes the few-shot transformation learning paradigm of the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC). Each task requires inferring a transformation rule from a few input-output pairs and applying it to a new test graph, covering local, global, and hierarchical graph

summary.core_problem: 现有抽象推理基准多局限于网格或文本格式，缺乏针对图结构数据的抽象推理评测基准，无法系统评估大模型的图变换泛化能力。
summary.importance: 基准贡献，首次将ARC的少样本抽象推理范式扩展到图结构领域，支持规模化生成多样化的图任务，可用于评估大模型的关系推理与泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 构建GraphARC基准，沿用ARC的少样本变换学习范式，覆盖局部、全局、层级三类图变换任务，可程序化生成跨多种图族和大小的实例，要求模型从少量输入输出对推断变换规则并应用到新测试图。
summary.experiments: 评测了SOTA大模型，发现模型可回答基础图属性问题，但常无法完成完整图变换任务，存在明显的理解-执行 gap，任务实例变大时性能进一步下降，暴露了推理能力的 scaling 障碍。
summary.authors_note: 来自ETH Zürich，Roger Wattenhofer为分布式系统与机器学习领域知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing abstract reasoning benchmarks are mostly limited to grid or text formats, lacking benchmarks for abstract reasoning on graph-structured data, making it impossible to systematically evaluate LLMs' graph transformation generalization ability.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, first extends ARC's few-shot abstract reasoning paradigm to graph-structured data, supports scalable generation of diverse graph tasks, and can be used to evaluate LLMs' relational reasoning and generalization capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds the GraphARC benchmark, follows ARC's few-shot transformation learning paradigm, covers local, global, and hierarchical graph transformation tasks, can procedurally generate instances across multiple graph families and sizes, and requires models to infer transformation rules from a few input-output pairs and apply them to new test graphs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs, finds that models can answer basic graph property questions but often fail to complete full graph transformation tasks, with a clear comprehension-execution gap; performance further degrades as task instance size increases, exposing scaling barriers in reasoning ability.
summary_en.authors_note: From ETH Zürich, Roger Wattenhofer is a well-known scholar in distributed systems and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 针对图抽象推理的新型基准，重点阅读§3任务设计和§5模型失效模式分析即可。
recommendation.en: Novel benchmark for graph abstract reasoning, only read §3 task design and §5 model failure mode analysis.

paper.title: Industrializing Prediction-Powered Inference: The GLIDE Library for Reliable GenAI and Agentic Systems Evaluation
paper.abstract: Reliable evaluation of agentic systems requires unbiased estimates with valid uncertainty, but standard practice navigates between costly human annotation and biased LLM-as-judge proxies. Prediction-powered inference (PPI) combines both into debiased estimates with valid confidence intervals, yet its various methods remain scattered across papers under partial implementations. We introduce GLIDE, an open-source Python library that unifies state-of-the-art PPI estimators (PPI++, Stratified PPI, P

summary.core_problem: GenAI与Agent系统的可靠评测需要带有效不确定性的无偏估计，现有方法要么依赖昂贵的人类标注，要么使用有偏的LLM-as-judge，PPI方法虽能结合二者优势但实现零散，缺乏统一的工业化库。
summary.importance: 工程系统贡献，首个统一了SOTA PPI估计器与采样器的开源Python库，解决了PPI方法的工业化落地问题，可大幅降低评测的标注成本。
summary.technical_approach: 开发GLIDE开源库，统一了PPI++、分层PPI、预测后去偏等SOTA PPI估计器，以及均匀、分层、主动、成本最优等采样器，提供scipy风格的API，附带蒙特卡洛验证套件、方法选择决策树与Agent评测案例。
summary.experiments: 通过蒙特卡洛实验验证了各估计器的有效性，在Agent评测案例中实现了同等精度下的大量标注成本节省。

summary_en.core_problem: Reliable evaluation of GenAI and agentic systems requires unbiased estimates with valid uncertainty, existing methods either rely on expensive human annotation or biased LLM-as-judge proxies; PPI methods combine the advantages of both but have scattered implementations, lacking a unified industrial-grade library.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution, first open-source Python library unifying state-of-the-art PPI estimators and samplers, solves the industrial deployment problem of PPI methods, and can significantly reduce annotation costs for evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops the GLIDE open-source library, unifies SOTA PPI estimators including PPI++, Stratified PPI, Predict-Then-Debias, and samplers including uniform, stratified, active, cost-optimal, provides a scipy-style API, and comes with a Monte Carlo validation suite, method selection decision tree, and agent evaluation case study.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the effectiveness of each estimator through Monte Carlo experiments, and achieves substantial annotation cost savings at equivalent precision in the agent evaluation case study.

recommendation.zh: 统一PPI评测方法的开源工具库，做模型或Agent评测时可直接复用，重点看API设计与方法选择决策树。
recommendation.en: Open-source library unifying PPI evaluation methods, can be directly reused for model or agent evaluation, focus on API design and method selection decision tree.

paper.title: Language Models Can Resolve Reference Compositionally, But It's Not Their Native Strength: The Case of the Personal Relation Task
paper.abstract: Do neural models, such as Large Language Models, genuinely acquire compositional abilities for interpretation of natural language? When we talk about semantic interpretation, we can distinguish two complementary aspects: establishing what an expression refers to in the world (which we call the Extensional task) and representing its sense in a structured way (which we call the Intensional task). We evaluate LLMs and humans on both tasks in the setting of the Personal Relation Task (Paperno 2022)

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 是否真正具备自然语言指称解析中的组合泛化能力，尤其区分“表达式结构表示”和“世界中实体指称”两类能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制与行为分析：它把组合语义拆成 intensional 表示任务和 extensional 指称任务，指出模型和人类的强弱项并不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Personal Relation Task：给定人物及关系图，要求解释如 “Amber's parent's friend” 的名词短语；intensional 任务输出结构化公式 friend(parent(amber))，extensional 任务输出具体人物。通过对比 LLM 与人类在两种任务上的表现来分析组合能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体模型清单、参数量或分数。主要实验结论是：人类在 extensional 指称任务上强于 intensional 公式任务，而 LLM 呈相反模式，说明模型更擅长符号形式重写，不天然擅长落到世界实体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether LLMs genuinely support compositional reference resolution by separating structured sense representation from resolving the referred entity in a world model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a behavioral and mechanistic analysis: compositional semantics is split into an intensional formula task and an extensional reference task, revealing different strengths for humans and LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It uses the Personal Relation Task, where a model is given a universe of people and their relations and must interpret noun phrases such as “Amber's parent's friend.” The intensional task asks for a structured formula like friend(parent(amber)); the extensional task asks for the actual person.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not list model families, sizes, or exact scores. The central finding is that humans perform better on the extensional task than on the intensional task, while LLMs show the opposite pattern.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务拆分和结果图；它提醒组合泛化评测别把公式重写误当成真实指称解析。
recommendation.en: Read only the task decomposition and result plots; it warns against mistaking formula rewriting for grounded reference resolution.

paper.title: ActTraitBench: Quantifying the Knowledge-Decision Gap in Large Language Models via Human-Grounded Behavioral Validation
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) can convincingly simulate personas in explicit self-reports, they often deviate in implicit behavioral decisions, revealing a substantial Knowledge-Decision Gap ($G_{\text{KD}}$). Existing benchmarks struggle to measure this asymmetry due to limited construct validity, multi-dimensional entanglement, and distributional biases in LLM-based evaluation. To address these issues, we propose ActTraitBench, a human-grounded evaluation framework for measuring personali

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM心理特质评估方法存在三个核心缺陷：无人类实证数据验证导致构念效度不足、多维度特质混杂无法分离单一心理维度、LLM-as-judge存在系统性分布偏差，无法准确量化模型显式人格宣称与隐式行为决策之间的知识-决策差距（G_KD）。
summary.importance: 为预训练与对齐研究提供了可靠的行为一致性评估指标，可用于量化基座模型的对齐质量、验证模型scaling与行为一致性的关联规律，也可指导对齐阶段的训练数据优化，支撑交互类Agent的对齐效果评估。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ActTraitBench人类锚定的评估框架，基于实证人类数据，将大五人格的各个心理测量维度映射到11种微观行为范式，通过非参数分位数映射方法将LLM评委的得分分布对齐人类标准，用于量化知识-决策差距。同时提出轻量即插即用的推理时策略「认知对齐链（CoCA）」缩小该差距。
summary.experiments: 对14个主流LLM的测试显示，知识-决策差距在所有模型世代中均存在，单纯模型scaling无法解决这种语用层面的不一致问题。CoCA策略可有效缩小具备推理能力模型的知识-决策差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题定义、基准构建的人类数据校准流程、14个模型的跨代测试结果。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM psychological trait evaluation methods have three critical limitations: unverified construct validity without human empirical validation, multi-dimensional trait entanglement that prevents isolation of single psychometric facets, and systematic distributional bias in LLM-as-judge evaluation. These issues make it impossible to accurately quantify the Knowledge-Decision Gap (G_KD) between LLMs' explicit personality claims and implicit behavioral decisions.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a reliable behavioral consistency evaluation metric for pretraining and alignment research. It can be used to quantify alignment quality of base models, verify the correlation between model scaling and behavioral consistency, guide training data optimization during alignment, and support alignment effect evaluation for interactive agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ActTraitBench, a human-grounded evaluation framework. Based on empirical human data, it maps Big Five psychometric facets to 11 micro-situational behavioral paradigms. A non-parametric quantile mapping procedure is applied to calibrate LLM-judge score distributions to human norms for G_KD quantification. A lightweight plug-and-play inference-time strategy named Chain of Cognitive Alignment (CoCA) is also proposed to narrow the gap.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation on 14 mainstream LLMs shows that G_KD exists across all model generations, and model scaling alone cannot resolve this pragmatic inconsistency. CoCA effectively narrows the gap for reasoning-capable models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem definition in Introduction, the human data calibration pipeline for benchmark construction, and the cross-generation evaluation results of 14 models. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了大模型能力越强、行为与自我报告偏差越大的反常识现象，只看§4实验结果与讨论即可
recommendation.en: Reveals the counterintuitive phenomenon that larger models have larger gaps between behavior and self-reports, only read §4 experimental results and discussion

paper.title: SpecBench: Evaluating Specification-Level Reasoning for Software Engineering LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Software engineering (SWE) agents are transitioning from code generation to full software development lifecycle automation. A critical phase in this lifecycle is specification design: transforming initial proposals into carefully considered requirements through expert review. Existing benchmarks such as SWE-Bench are implementation-focused by measuring the agent's ability to generate code given fixed, precise design requirements. This formulation assumes specifications are correct and complete.

summary.core_problem: 现有 SWE agent 基准（如 SWE-Bench）默认“规格说明是完美的”，只测从明确需求到代码实现的能力，无法覆盖真实工程里最难也最关键的阶段：在需求不完整/有歧义/有冲突时，识别规格缺陷并推动规格走向可实现、可验证的一致版本。SpecBench 要评测的就是这种 specification-level reasoning：给定初始 RFC 提案、当时的代码库快照、以及此前的 RFC 历史，模型能否指出提案中哪些地方会导致实现风险或社区不可接受。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在“训练方法”，而在评测信号：它把 agent 能力从“写对代码”前移到“把需求写对”。这类能力与预训练阶段的长文档理解、跨文档一致性建模、价值/规范对齐（社区设计哲学）、以及检索式上下文利用强相关。对做数据与训练动态的人，SpecBench 提供了一个更贴近真实分布的长上下文推理与规范对齐压力测试：模型是否能从历史 RFC 里抽取隐含约束，并用它们去挑错当前提案，而不是只靠通用编程常识。
summary.technical_approach:
基准设计围绕“规格缺陷识别”这一子任务展开（作者明确说完整版本还会包含“修订规格”能力，但本文先聚焦识别）。任务构造依托开源社区成熟的 RFC 流程（文中点名 Rust / Kubernetes / React 等）：
1) 输入：初始 RFC 设计提案 + 提案提出前的代码库状态（最新 commit before proposal）+ 提案提出前的 RFC 历史（包含更早 RFC 的提案、讨论、最终接受/拒绝结果）。评测时禁止访问提案日期之后的任何信息，避免“事后诸葛”式泄漏。
2) 输出：模型需要预测 specification deficiencies，即提案中导致行为/约束“不完整、歧义、不一致、不可验证或不安全”的问题点。
3) 缺陷类型：采用 IEEE Std. 1028-1997 的 anomaly 分类并结合软件规格研究，将缺陷归为 Omission（遗漏必要信息）、Ambiguous（多义）、Inconsistent（内部或与现有系统冲突）、Incorrect（与既有信息矛盾/错误）。
4) 关键取舍：不让模型写代码，刻意把实现能力从评测中剥离，避免 SWE-Bench 式“靠补丁通过测试”掩盖规格层面的缺陷；同时引入“社区价值对齐”维度——不同社区的设计哲学不同，模型需要从历史讨论中学习隐含规范，而不是输出泛化的 checklist。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段主要覆盖动机与基准构造，未包含完整实验表格与具体分数细节（例如不同模型在各缺陷类型上的准确率/召回、长上下文长度敏感性、是否使用检索等）。从设计上可以预期的关键实验维度包括：
- 不同输入组成的消融：仅 RFC 提案 vs. 提案+代码库 vs. 提案+历史 RFC（检验“社区规范/历史先例”是否是主要增益来源）。
- 缺陷类型分布与难度：Omission/ Ambiguous 往往更依赖隐含约束与可验证性意识；Inconsistent/Incorrect 更依赖跨文档对齐与对现有系统行为的理解。
- 上下文长度与检索策略：历史 RFC 可能很长，模型是否需要 RAG/分段摘要才能稳定发挥。
但这些需要以论文完整实验章节为准；当前提供内容不足以引用具体数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看动机与 Figure 1（设计生命周期分解：proposal→review→final spec→implementation），理解它为何要把评测从“实现”前移到“规格”。
- 精看 SpecBench Design：输入时间截断（proposal date 之前的 code/RFC history）、缺陷定义、以及缺陷分类（IEEE 1028-1997 四类）。这部分决定了它和 SWE-Bench 的根本差异。
- 关注“community value alignment”这条主线：它暗示了评测不仅是逻辑一致性，还包含从历史决策中学习规范偏好；这对预训练数据配比（技术讨论语料、RFC/issue/pr 讨论）与长上下文建模很敏感。
如果要用于训练/数据研究，建议额外追问：标注/答案是如何从真实讨论中抽取的、是否存在多解、以及如何避免模型用表面模式匹配而非真正的约束推导。

summary_en.core_problem: Most SWE-agent benchmarks assume a perfect, fully specified requirement and only test implementation-level reasoning (turning a fixed spec into code that passes tests). SpecBench targets an earlier and often harder stage in real software development: specification-level reasoning—detecting deficiencies in an initial design proposal (incompleteness, ambiguity, inconsistency, incorrectness) before implementation, using the project’s codebase snapshot and prior RFC history available at the time the proposal was made.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation signal rather than a new training method. For foundation-model pretraining research, SpecBench is useful as a stress test for long-context understanding, cross-document consistency, and norm/value conditioning: models must infer implicit constraints from historical RFC discussions and apply community-specific design philosophies (e.g., safety vs. API stability) to critique a new proposal. This connects directly to data mixture choices (technical discussions, RFC/issue threads), retrieval-augmented context usage, and robustness to long, noisy deliberative text.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SpecBench is built around the sub-capability of identifying spec deficiencies (the paper notes that a full version would also evaluate spec revision, but this work focuses on detection). Tasks are grounded in real open-source RFC processes (Rust/Kubernetes/React mentioned):
- Inputs: (1) the initial RFC proposal, (2) the project repository at the latest commit before the proposal, and (3) the entire prior RFC history (older proposals, discussions, accept/reject outcomes). Agents are restricted from accessing any information after the proposal date.
- Output: a set of predicted specification deficiencies—issues that make the proposal incomplete, ambiguous, inconsistent, unverifiable, or unsafe to implement without clarification.
- Taxonomy: deficiencies are categorized using IEEE Std. 1028-1997 anomaly classes plus prior spec-quality work: Omission, Ambiguous, Inconsistent, Incorrect.
- Key design choice: no code generation during evaluation, to decouple spec reasoning from “patch-and-pass-tests” implementation skill, and to surface community-norm alignment as a first-class requirement.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt covers motivation and benchmark design but does not include the main experimental tables or quantitative results (e.g., model scores by deficiency type, ablations on using codebase vs. RFC history, context-length sensitivity, or retrieval). Likely informative experimental axes—pending the actual results section—include: (i) proposal-only vs. proposal+code vs. proposal+prior-RFC ablations to measure the value of historical norms, (ii) performance breakdown across Omission/Ambiguous/Inconsistent/Incorrect, and (iii) long-context and RAG effects given potentially large RFC histories.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Start with the motivation and the lifecycle figure (proposal → review/revision → final spec → implementation) to internalize why implementation-centric benchmarks miss a key capability.
- Read the SpecBench Design section carefully: the time cutoff (pre-proposal snapshots), the definition of “spec deficiencies,” and the IEEE-based taxonomy. This is where the benchmark’s differentiator lives.
- Pay attention to the “community value alignment” angle; it implies the benchmark is partly about learning norms from historical deliberation, which is directly relevant to pretraining data and long-context modeling.
If using it for training/data research, the next step is to inspect how gold deficiencies are derived from real discussions, how ambiguity/multi-solution cases are handled, and what prevents shallow pattern matching.

recommendation.zh: 将 SWE Agent 的评测从“写代码”前置到了“写 RFC/需求规约”，这是一个更接近真实高级工程师工作流的 Benchmark，值得关注其评测指标设计。
recommendation.en: Shifts SWE agent evaluation from 'writing code' to 'writing RFCs/specifications', a benchmark closer to real senior engineer workflows; worth checking its metric design.

paper.title: Resolution Diagnostics for Paired LLM Evaluation
paper.abstract: Across two public LLM leaderboards, many displayed pairwise rankings do not meet a conventional paired-test resolution target under the actual paired evaluation design: 11 of 40 Open LLM Leaderboard v1 pairwise comparisons and 4 of 9 MMLU-Pro top-10 adjacent-rank pairs are unresolved at (alpha, 1-beta) = (0.05, 0.8). The MMLU-Pro count rises to 6/9 under real subject-level clustering and stays at 5-6 out of 9 in 99.9% of category-bootstrap resamples. We frame paired LLM evaluation as a hypothesi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM leaderboard 的分辨率问题：两个模型在同一组 prompt 上相差几个百分点时，这个差距是否足以支持“模型 A 优于模型 B”的统计判断。作者把共享 prompt 的评测明确建模为 paired hypothesis testing，而不是把两个模型分数当作独立样本比较。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的价值在评测层面。预训练 recipe、数据配比和模型架构经常依赖 leaderboard 上的小幅差距做决策，但很多相邻排名没有足够样本量支撑。该工作给出一个可执行的 resolution protocol，用 q = N / N* 表示当前 benchmark 是否有足够分辨率。它不会改进模型，但能降低评测噪声对 pretrain 方向选择的误导，尤其适合 MMLU、HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro 这类共享题目评测。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线是把每个 prompt 上两个模型的得分差记为 D_i，然后根据得分类型选择 paired test。二分类 accuracy 使用 McNemar test 和 Connor required-N 公式；连续或分级分数可用 paired t-test 或 paired bootstrap。作者反推出三个诊断量：当前 N 下的 minimum detectable effect，给定目标 effect 所需的 N*，以及 resolution ratio q = N / N*。q < 1 表示当前样本量不足以在指定 Type-I error 和 power 下分辨该差距。工作还加入 multiplicity correction、cluster design effect、category bootstrap、leave-one-subject-out sensitivity 和 anytime-valid e-process，以处理 leaderboard 中多重比较、学科聚类和顺序查看结果的问题。一个理论补充是分析常见 unpaired Cohen-h 加 (1-rho) 修正的误用，说明它会在小效应区间系统性低估所需样本量，领先项约为 2 倍，并给出二阶常数。
summary.experiments: 作者重分析了两个公开 leaderboard。Open LLM Leaderboard v1 中，40 个展示的 pairwise comparisons 有 11 个在 alpha=0.05、power=0.8 目标下未解析。MMLU-Pro top-10 的 9 个相邻排名中，IID 假设下有 4 个未解析；考虑 14 个 subject category 的真实聚类后，未解析数升至 6/9；category bootstrap 中 99.9% 的重采样保持在 5 到 6 个未解析。一个具体例子是 HellaSwag 上 gemma-7B 与 Llama-3-8B 的 0.46 个百分点差距：渐近 chi-square 给 p=0.049，但 exact conditional binomial 给 p=0.054，paired bootstrap 95% CI 覆盖 0。方法校准方面，paired-McNemar 所需 N 相比 unpaired Gaussian 公式中位数小 2.15 倍，IQR 为 [1.60, 2.75]；在三个真实 OLL v1 pair 上，按 N* 采样得到的经验 McNemar power 为 0.80±0.03，0.8N* 和 1.2N* 分别按预期低估和高估 power。作者还检查了五个常见 power-analysis 工具，其中三个在特定误用模式下会把所需 N 低估约 2 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。先看方法定义里的 q、MDE 和 N*，这是最实用的部分；再看 paired binary accuracy 的 McNemar 实例，因为大多数 LLM benchmark 都是共享题目的对错评分；最后看 Table 5、MMLU-Pro cluster sensitivity 和 appendix 中的 calibration。若只做模型训练，可以跳过理论 lemma 的证明细节；若维护 benchmark 或 leaderboard，需要仔细看 multiplicity、cluster correction 和 anytime-valid sequential testing 的设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the statistical resolution of LLM leaderboards. When two models differ by a small number of percentage points on the same prompts, the relevant question is whether the benchmark has enough paired sample size to support the displayed ranking. The authors formulate shared-prompt evaluation as a paired testing problem rather than an unpaired comparison of aggregate scores.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in evaluation reliability. Model, data, and recipe choices are often made from small leaderboard gaps, but many adjacent rankings do not have enough resolution under conventional type-I error and power targets. The proposed diagnostic, q = N / N*, gives a direct indication of whether the current benchmark size can distinguish a target gap. This is useful for interpreting MMLU-style and HellaSwag-style results where the same items are evaluated across models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method represents each prompt by a paired difference D_i between model A and model B. For binary accuracy it uses McNemar-style paired testing and Connor required-sample calculations; for graded scores it allows paired t-tests or paired bootstrap procedures. By inverting level-alpha, power-(1-beta) tests, the framework reports the minimum detectable effect at current N, the required paired sample size N* for a target effect, and the resolution ratio q. Values below one indicate insufficient resolution. The pipeline also includes multiplicity corrections, cluster design effects, category bootstrap, leave-one-subject-out sensitivity, and anytime-valid e-processes for sequential monitoring. A theoretical component analyzes a common misuse of unpaired Cohen-h power calculators with a post-hoc (1-rho) correction, showing a systematic factor-of-two sample-size error in the small-effect regime and providing an explicit second-order term.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical reanalysis covers two public leaderboard settings. On Open LLM Leaderboard v1, 11 of 40 displayed pairwise comparisons fail the target resolution level at alpha = 0.05 and power = 0.8. On MMLU-Pro top-10 adjacent ranks, 4 of 9 pairs are unresolved under an IID assumption; after accounting for the 14 subject categories as clusters, the unresolved count rises to 6 of 9, and category bootstrap resampling keeps the count at 5 to 6 in 99.9% of resamples. A concrete example is the gemma-7B versus Llama-3-8B HellaSwag gap of 0.46 percentage points: the asymptotic chi-square test gives p = 0.049, while the exact conditional binomial gives p = 0.054 and the paired-bootstrap 95% interval includes zero. The calibration study shows that paired-McNemar required N is a median 2.15 times smaller than an unpaired Gaussian formula on the same data, with IQR [1.60, 2.75]. On three real OLL v1 pairs, the prescribed N* achieves empirical McNemar power of 0.80 ± 0.03 over 1000 bootstrap trials, while 0.8N* and 1.2N* undershoot and overshoot as expected.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time is around 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the definitions of MDE, N*, and q, since these are the reusable diagnostics. Then read the paired-binary accuracy section and the McNemar examples, which match many common LLM benchmarks. The most practically useful empirical parts are the final verdict table, the MMLU-Pro cluster-sensitivity analysis, and the finite-sample calibration appendix. The proof of the calculator-misuse lemma can be skipped unless you are building power-analysis tooling or designing a new leaderboard protocol.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM Leaderboard 统计显著性的硬核打假，指出很多相邻排名其实是 noise，做 eval 体系的同学必看。
recommendation.en: Hardcore statistical debunking of LLM leaderboards, pointing out that many adjacent rankings are just noise. A must-read for those building evaluation systems.

paper.title: Conf-Gen: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification for Generative Models
paper.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) and its extension, conformal risk control (CRC), are established frameworks for quantifying uncertainty in supervised machine learning through formal guarantees. However, recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence (AI) have been driven by unsupervised generative models, such as large language models (LLMs) and image generators, which are not directly compatible with CP or CRC. In this work we introduce conformal generation (Conf-Gen), a general framework adapting C

summary.core_problem: 共形预测（CP）和共形风险控制（CRC）为监督学习提供了分布无关的不确定性量化保证，但无法直接应用于生成式模型（LLM、图像生成器等），因为生成任务的输出空间是无约束的，且缺乏明确定义的 ground-truth 目标。
summary.importance: Conf-Gen 提供了一个将共形方法扩展到生成式模型的通用框架，统一了以往针对特定任务的共形 LLM 方法，并将共形 UQ 拓展到全新的应用领域（图像生成、对话式 LLM 澄清问题、Agent 输出序列、随机森林子集选择）。对于 LLM 预训练研究者而言，其在问答任务上的应用展示了如何用共形保证来约束 LLM 的输出空间，这对可靠的推理和对齐具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: Conf-Gen 扩展了 CRC 的效用函数框架，用'可容许性'（admissibility）替代传统的效用概念，适用于序列等比集合更一般的结构。理论上放松了 CRC 的单调性假设，推导出更一般的期望效用上界（反界）。框架的核心是定义一个非一致性评分函数 s(x, y) 和一个容许性概念 A(x, y)，然后通过校准数据选择阈值，使得所选结构的期望可容许性被下界约束。论文还识别了使计算可行的设计模式，并提供了 Python 包。
summary.experiments: 在 LLM 问答任务上，Conf-Gen 相比现有共形基线提供了更紧的保证；在图像生成任务上，展示了如何生成非记忆化图像并附有共形保证；在对话式 LLM 上，可确保模型已提出足够的澄清问题；在 Agent 序列输出上，保证生成的动作序列包含正确解；在随机森林上，保证所选子树包含足够多做出正确预测的树。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（Conf-Gen 框架的形式化定义）、第 4 节（理论保证，特别是放松单调性假设和反界推导）、以及第 5 节（应用实例，尤其是 LLM QA 部分）。对预训练研究者，附录中关于评分函数选择和校准效率的讨论值得关注。预计阅读时间 40-60 分钟（含理论部分）。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Layer 6 AI Labs 的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Conformal prediction (CP) and conformal risk control (CRC) provide distribution-free uncertainty quantification guarantees for supervised learning, but cannot be directly applied to generative models (LLMs, image generators, etc.) because generative tasks have unconstrained output spaces and lack well-defined ground-truth targets.
summary_en.importance: Conf-Gen provides a general framework for extending conformal methods to generative models, unifying prior task-specific conformal LLM approaches and extending conformal UQ to entirely new domains (image generation, conversational LLM clarification, agent output sequences, random forest subset selection). For LLM pretraining researchers, its application to QA demonstrates how conformal guarantees can constrain LLM output spaces — directly relevant to reliable reasoning and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conf-Gen extends CRC's utility function framework by replacing the traditional utility concept with 'admissibility,' which applies to structures more general than sets, such as sequences. Theoretically, it relaxes CRC's monotonicity assumption and derives a more general reverse (upper) bound on expected utility. The framework's core defines a nonconformity score function s(x,y) and an admissibility notion A(x,y), then selects a threshold via calibration data to lower-bound the expected admissibility of selected structures. The paper also identifies design patterns that make computation tractable and provides a Python package.
summary_en.experiments: On LLM QA, Conf-Gen provides tighter guarantees than existing conformal baselines. On image generation, it demonstrates generating non-memorized images with conformal guarantees. For conversational LLMs, it ensures the model has asked enough clarifying questions. For agentic AI, it guarantees a generated action sequence contains a correct solution. For random forests, it guarantees a selected subset of trees contains enough trees making correct predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (formal definition of the Conf-Gen framework), Section 4 (theoretical guarantees, especially relaxed monotonicity and reverse bound derivation), and Section 5 (applications, particularly LLM QA). For pretraining researchers, the appendix discussion on score function choices and calibration efficiency is worth attention. Estimated reading time: 40-60 minutes (including theory).
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Layer 6 AI Labs.

recommendation.zh: 生成模型的不确定性量化终于有了通用的理论框架，可用于预训练阶段的幻觉检测和数据污染排查，重点看理论推导和LLM应用部分
recommendation.en: Generative model uncertainty quantification now has a general theoretical framework, applicable for hallucination detection and data contamination screening in pretraining; focus on the theoretical derivation and LLM application sections

paper.title: Let the Results Speak: A Replication-First Paradigm for LLM Behavioral Benchmarking
paper.abstract: Subjective evaluation of LLM behavior -- empathy, restraint, calibrated emotional tone -- is hard. Human inter-rater agreement on such qualities saturates near rho ~ 0.45, and an LLM-as-judge proxy alone risks circularity: a judge sharing the target's training cohort cannot independently verify it. Anchoring validity to a single human-rater consensus does not extend to capabilities where humans themselves disagree.   We propose a replication-first paradigm: instead of anchoring on one rater grou

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个评测方法问题：当被评估能力本身高度主观，且人类标注者之间的一致性上限就不高时，LLM 行为评测该如何建立可信度。作者针对 emotional accompaniment 这类对话行为，指出“和人类评分相关”这个常见验证标准已经不够用：一方面，人类在共情、克制、情绪语气这类维度上的个体间一致性通常只有约 ρ≈0.45；另一方面，单个 LLM judge 还会带来训练同源导致的循环验证问题。论文要解决的不是再造一个更强 judge，而是提出一套不依赖单一人类共识的 instrument validation 框架，让评测工具的可信度由重复性、跨仪器复现、历史校准和前瞻预测来共同支撑。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于“情感陪伴”这个任务本身，而在于它给出了 frontier 模型行为评测的一种更稳的做法。预训练和后训练越来越多地优化那些难以用客观答案衡量的行为属性，例如帮助性、克制性、人格稳定性、情绪校准、拒答风格。这类属性如果只靠单 judge 或少量人类共识来做训练闭环，很容易把噪声当信号。作者提出的 replication-first 范式，实质上是在给主观行为评测建立 measurement discipline：先证明量具稳定、可复现、能识别历史变化、还能做出可证伪预测，再把它用于模型比较。这个思路对 post-train reward design、judge model 选择、行为回归监控都很有启发。更具体地说，论文展示了 aggregate score 会掩盖维度级退化，这一点对训练过程中的 regression detection 很重要。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有四个关键部件。第一是 rubric 构建。作者不是先拍脑袋定维度，而是通过 self-evolved discrimination-maximization 过程，让维度集合在迭代中稳定到 9 个行为维度，用来覆盖 emotional accompaniment 中更细的行为结构，例如 empathic reflection、advice restraint、safety calibration、persona stability、emotional trajectory tracking 等。这样做的目的，是避免单一总分把不同能力混在一起，也避免人为先验把量表限制死。

第二是四证书式 instrument trust。作者借 classical measurement theory，把评测有效性拆成四类证据：reliability，要求同一工具多次测量结果稳定；cross-instrument replication，要求不同架构、不同训练世代的 judge 在同一对象上给出相近排序；historical-footprint calibration，要求量表能识别已知架构代际变化带来的行为跃迁；pre-registered prediction，要求量表在未观测数据上做出事先承诺、可失败的预测。这套设计的重点，是把“validity”从“和某一组人一致”转成“能否在世界中稳定工作并经得起外部检验”。

第三是 judge 设计。作者使用 5-judge ensemble，覆盖 5 个模型家族，并刻意拉开 17 个月训练 cohort gap，以降低 judge 与 target 同源带来的循环性。文中还报告了 cross-timeline judges 的一致性，以及在 held-out 真实人类对话上的跨家族收敛情况。这里的核心不是 ensemble 本身，而是“异质 judge + 时间错位 judge”共同提供独立性证据。

第四是预注册与审计。作者在收集 Slice 2/3 数据前，预注册了 10 个可证伪假设和 11 个 forward predictions，并保留 4-artifact audit trail。这个部分很像严肃实验科学中的 protocol discipline，目的是防止在主观评测里事后挑结果、调 rubric、改解释。对 LLM 评测来说，这比单纯多跑几个 benchmark 更接近可审计测量。
summary.experiments:
实验主体是 49 个模型、8 个家族的面板评测，场景选在 emotional accompaniment，因为这里人类本来就难达成高一致性，而且 frontier 模型覆盖较密。最重要的结果不是谁总分最高，而是作者发现了 aggregate score 掩盖的维度级回归。

最醒目的例子在 advice_restraint 维度。OpenAI 代际中，gpt-5 相比 gpt-4.1 下降 1.87 分，被作者称为 24 个月 OpenAI 轨迹里最大的单步下降；Anthropic 代际中，Opus-4.7 相比 Opus-4.6 下降 0.629 分。但如果只看 aggregate score，这两个变化分别约为 0 和 -0.12，很容易被当作噪声忽略。作者还给了一个 Qwen3.5→Qwen3.6 的方向性结果，但明确标注 n=2，因此没有放进 headline regression。

稳健性方面，headline regression 在 3 个独立 user-proxy swap 下保留了 95% 的幅度，说明结论不是某个用户代理写法偶然造成的。可靠性指标上，instrument 达到 Krippendorff α_ord=0.91，5-judge ensemble 的 Spearman-Brown 投影 ρ_{K=5}=0.984，说明量表内部和 ensemble 后的一致性都很高。跨时间 judge 的 capability-graded 相关在 ρ∈[0.37,0.62]，不算极高，但足以说明不同训练世代的 judge 对主要趋势有可复现共识。更关键的是，在 74 条 held-out、rubric 未见过的真实 ESConv 人类对话上，来自 4 个家族的 4 个 judge 收敛到 ρ∈[0.749,0.850]，这给了外部泛化证据。

从实验设计看，作者刻意把“发现隐藏回归”作为主目标，而不是做一个新的 leaderboard。这个取向是合理的，因为论文要证明的是 measurement instrument 能否揭示被总分掩盖的行为变化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一看 Introduction 和方法总览，理解作者为什么放弃“human agreement as gold standard”，以及四证书框架分别在解决什么问题。第二看 §3.2 的 regression 结果，尤其是 advice_restraint 在 gpt-4.1→gpt-5、Opus-4.6→4.7 上的变化；这是全文最有信息量的实证点。第三看 reliability / cross-judge / held-out replication 相关表格，确认作者不是靠单一 judge 或单一数据切片得出结论。

如果只给 20-30 分钟，建议读：Introduction、Table 1、headline results、可靠性指标、held-out replication。若再多花一点时间，值得看 rubric 是如何 self-evolve 到 9 维的，以及预注册假设和 forward predictions 的具体内容，因为这决定了这套方法是否真能避免事后调参式评测。

阅读时要特别留意一个边界：这篇论文证明的是“某类主观行为评测可以更可信”，不是证明 judge 已经等价于人类，也不是证明 emotional accompaniment 的 9 维量表就是唯一正确分解。真正值得深挖的是它把评测从相关性思路转成 measurement-theoretic 思路，这对训练闭环中的 judge 设计更重要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a measurement problem rather than a modeling problem: how to validate LLM behavioral evaluation when the target capability is inherently subjective and human agreement is itself low. The authors focus on emotional accompaniment and argue that the usual criterion—correlation with human ratings—breaks down in this regime. Individual human agreement on qualities such as empathy, restraint, and emotional calibration saturates around ρ≈0.45, while a single LLM judge introduces circularity if it shares the same training cohort as the target model. The central question is therefore not how to build a stronger judge, but how to establish trust in the evaluation instrument without relying on a single human-consensus anchor.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is methodological. As pretraining and post-training increasingly optimize behavioral properties that do not have objective answers—helpfulness, restraint, persona stability, emotional tone, refusal style—the field needs evaluation instruments that are stable enough to support training decisions. This paper proposes a replication-first validation paradigm that is closer to measurement science than to standard benchmark practice. The practical implication is clear: if reward models, judge models, or regression dashboards are built on noisy subjective labels, training can optimize artifacts. The paper also shows that aggregate scores can hide dimension-level regressions, which is directly relevant for model iteration and behavior monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has four main components. First, the rubric is not fixed a priori. The authors use a self-evolved, discrimination-maximization procedure and report that it stabilizes to a 9-dimensional rubric for emotional accompaniment. The dimensions include behaviors such as empathic reflection, advice restraint, safety calibration, persona stability, and emotional trajectory tracking. This matters because a single scalar score would collapse distinct behaviors and make regressions hard to detect.

Second, they introduce a four-certificate instrument-trust framework inspired by classical measurement theory. The four certificates are: reliability, meaning repeated measurements by the same instrument are consistent; cross-instrument replication, meaning judges from different architectural families and training cohorts converge on the same readings; historical-footprint calibration, meaning the instrument detects known architecture-era transitions as behavioral shifts; and pre-registered prediction, meaning the instrument makes falsifiable forecasts on data not yet collected. The key move is to shift validity away from “agreement with one rater group” toward “stability and external testability in the world.”

Third, the judge setup is deliberately heterogeneous. They use a 5-judge ensemble spanning five model families and a 17-month training-cohort gap. This is meant to reduce same-cohort circularity and provide a stronger independence argument than a single LLM-as-judge setup. The paper also reports agreement across timeline-separated judges and convergence on held-out real human conversations.

Fourth, the study is pre-registered and auditable. The authors commit to 10 falsifiable hypotheses and 11 forward predictions before collecting later data slices, and they maintain a four-artifact audit trail. This is important because subjective evaluation is especially vulnerable to post hoc rubric adjustment and selective reporting.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study evaluates 49 models across 8 families on emotional accompaniment. The most important result is not a leaderboard ranking but the discovery of dimension-level regressions that aggregate scores wash out.

The clearest example is advice_restraint. In the OpenAI lineage, GPT-5 drops by 1.87 points relative to GPT-4.1, which the authors describe as the largest single-step decline in their 24-month OpenAI arc. In the Anthropic lineage, Opus-4.7 drops by 0.629 relative to Opus-4.6. Yet the corresponding aggregate-score changes are about 0 and -0.12, small enough that a standard leaderboard view would likely dismiss them as noise. A directional Qwen3.5→Qwen3.6 result is also reported, but explicitly marked as n=2 and excluded from the headline regression claim.

On robustness, the headline regression preserves 95% of its magnitude under three independent user-proxy swaps, suggesting the effect is not an artifact of one prompt persona. Reliability metrics are strong: Krippendorff α_ord=0.91 and a 5-judge Spearman-Brown projected reliability of ρ_{K=5}=0.984. Agreement across timeline-separated judges is more moderate, with capability-graded ρ in [0.37, 0.62], but still sufficient to support replication of the main directional findings. On 74 held-out real human ESConv conversations unseen by the rubric, four judges from four families converge at ρ in [0.749, 0.850], which is the strongest external-generalization evidence in the paper.

The experimental design is intentionally aimed at showing whether the instrument can surface hidden behavioral regressions, not at producing another broad benchmark table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and method overview to understand why the paper rejects human-agreement-as-gold-standard in this setting and what each of the four certificates is meant to establish. Second, read the regression section, especially the advice_restraint results for GPT-4.1→GPT-5 and Opus-4.6→4.7; this is the most informative empirical contribution. Third, inspect the reliability, cross-judge, and held-out replication tables to verify that the claims do not rest on a single judge or a single slice of data.

If time is limited to 20–30 minutes, read the introduction, Table 1, the headline results, the reliability metrics, and the held-out replication section. If you spend more time, the rubric-construction procedure and the pre-registered hypotheses are worth reading carefully, because they determine whether the framework genuinely avoids post hoc evaluation drift.

A useful reading stance is to keep the scope narrow: the paper does not prove that LLM judges are equivalent to humans, nor that this 9-dimensional rubric is uniquely correct. What it does offer is a more disciplined way to validate subjective behavioral instruments, which is the part most relevant to training loops and judge design.

recommendation.zh: 主观行为 eval 的 setup 比常见 LLM-as-judge 干净；读四项认证标准，别太在意具体情绪任务。
recommendation.en: The evaluation setup is cleaner than a vanilla LLM-as-judge study; read the four certification criteria, not the emotion task.

paper.title: Causal methods for LLM development and evaluation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) development is currently driven by large-scale empirical iteration over data mixtures, reward models, routing strategies, and evaluation pipelines. Here, we argue that many central questions in LLM development and evaluation are inherently causal: What is the effect of adding a data domain during pretraining? How do annotator preferences change when LLMs generate text in a different style? Should a prompt be routed to a larger or smaller model given inference cost cons

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的不是某个具体模型，而是一个长期被工程实践忽略的问题：LLM 开发和评测中的很多关键决策，本质上都是因果问题，但当前流程往往用相关性、离线日志平均值或简单 A/B 近似来替代。作者要解决的是，如何把 pretrain 数据配比、对齐策略、路由、judge、arena、agent workflow 等环节统一表述为“干预—结果”的问题，并说明在什么条件下可以用因果方法得到更可靠、更省标注、更能抗偏差的结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义，不在于它给出一个新的训练 recipe，而在于它提供了一套更严谨的决策框架，尤其适合那些无法频繁做大规模随机实验的问题。比如预训练里常见的“加入某个数据域到底有没有帮助”“某种数据清洗策略是否真的改善下游能力”“某类合成数据是否只是和评测分布更像”这类问题，单靠观测相关性很容易误判。文章的贡献更像方法论地基：把 LLM 开发中的数据选择、反馈偏差、路由偏差、评测偏差，统一放进因果推断视角下讨论。对于做大规模训练的人，这种视角的价值在于减少错误归因，避免把 confounding 当成 recipe 经验。
summary.technical_approach:
这是一篇立场和框架型论文，不是提出单一算法。技术内容主要分三层。

第一层是问题形式化。作者用潜在结果框架把 LLM 开发中的系统选择写成 treatment A，环境或上下文写成 X，结果写成 Y。这里的 A 可以是预训练数据混合权重、prompt 模板、router 决策、retrieval policy、judge 配置、对齐策略等；Y 可以是 perplexity、任务成功率、偏好分数、安全指标、延迟或综合 utility。这样一来，工程上常问的“如果换一种配置会怎样”就变成估计 E[Y(a)] 或 treatment effect 的问题。

第二层是场景映射。全文把因果方法放到了 LLM pipeline 的多个位置：pretraining 数据决策、alignment 与 preference data、deployment 中的 routing、evaluation 中的 arena 和 LLM-as-a-judge、以及 agentic workflow。作者反复强调一个共同点：这些环节大量依赖历史日志，而日志不是随机采样得到的，常常带有 selection bias、policy-induced bias、label bias 和 distribution shift。比如大模型路由系统会把更难的问题分给更大的模型，若直接比较日志结果，可能错误得出“大模型更差”的结论。

第三层是方法原则。文章讨论了在 LLM 场景中应用因果推断时需要满足或近似满足的条件，如可识别性、混杂控制、重叠性、稳定性，以及如何结合现代因果机器学习工具处理高维特征、偏差反馈和有限标注预算。虽然全文更偏综述和议程设置，但它并不是泛泛而谈，而是在每个环节都指出了为什么 observational logs 不够、随机实验为什么贵、因果估计能补什么缺口。

从预训练角度看，最有用的是它把“数据 mixture 选择”明确当成 intervention 问题，而不是经验调参问题。这个表述很重要，因为它自然引出反事实问题：如果不加入某个域，或者把某域权重从 5% 改到 15%，最终能力变化到底来自数据本身，还是来自与 tokenizer、训练步数、评测集重叠、课程顺序等因素的耦合。
summary.experiments:
这篇文章的核心不是实验突破，而是框架梳理与案例化论证。全文没有像方法论文那样给出统一 benchmark 上的大规模数字对比，重点是通过多个开发场景说明 naïve observational comparison 会怎样失真，以及因果方法在哪些地方能提供更稳健的估计。

从内容结构看，作者主要给出的是问题实例、偏差来源和可行研究方向，而不是一个完整的实证系统。因此阅读时不要期待新的训练曲线或大模型性能表。更应该关注的是它如何拆解偏差来源：例如路由导致的样本难度偏差、人工偏好评测中的风格偏差、arena 或 judge 中因展示顺序和回答长度带来的系统性偏差、以及 agent 环境中序列决策造成的反馈回路。

如果只从“实验结果”角度衡量，这篇论文信息密度不高；但如果从研究设计角度看，它给出的案例足够具体，能帮助重新审视很多常见离线分析结论是否可信。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着具体问题去读，而不是从头到尾逐段细看。

如果你关心预训练，优先看引言和关于 pretraining data decisions 的部分，重点理解作者为什么把数据配比、数据域增删视为因果干预，而不是普通超参搜索。

如果你关心评测与对齐，重点看 human preference、LLM-as-a-judge、arena 和 routing 的章节。这里对偏差来源的拆解比较清楚，能直接映射到日常实验设计。

阅读时建议抓三个问题：1）这里的 treatment、context、outcome 分别是什么；2）日志数据为什么不能直接比较；3）若要做因果估计，最难满足的识别条件是什么。按这个框架读，会比把它当一般综述更有收获。

预计 20 到 30 分钟可以读完主线；如果要把其中的方法真正落到自己的训练或评测流程里，还需要额外补因果推断基础。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about a new model architecture. It addresses a broader but important gap: many central decisions in LLM development and evaluation are inherently causal, yet they are often handled with correlational analysis, naive offline comparisons, or limited A/B testing. The paper asks how to systematically frame choices such as pretraining data mixture changes, alignment interventions, routing policies, judge configurations, and agent workflows as intervention-effect questions, and when causal methods can produce more reliable conclusions from biased logs.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is methodological rather than recipe-driven. The paper offers a more disciplined way to reason about questions like whether adding a data domain actually helps, whether a filtering policy improves downstream capability or merely changes overlap with evaluation sets, and whether synthetic data gains are real or confounded. For large-scale training work, this matters because many decisions are too expensive to test with full randomized experiments. A causal framing helps reduce misattribution: it separates the effect of a development choice from artifacts induced by selection bias, feedback loops, or evaluation bias.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is a perspective and framework paper rather than a single-method contribution. Its technical content has three main layers.

First, it formalizes LLM development decisions in the potential-outcomes framework. A system choice is treated as an intervention or treatment A, observed context as X, and the outcome of interest as Y. In this setup, A may represent a pretraining data mixture, prompt template, routing assignment, retrieval policy, judge configuration, or alignment strategy; Y may be perplexity, task success, preference score, safety metric, latency, or a combined utility. This turns common engineering questions into estimands such as E[Y(a)] or treatment effects.

Second, the paper maps this framing across the LLM pipeline: pretraining data decisions, alignment and preference collection, deployment-time routing, evaluation through arenas and LLM-as-a-judge, and agentic workflows. The recurring argument is that these settings rely heavily on observational logs rather than randomized data, and those logs are shaped by prior policies, annotator behavior, and evolving environments. As a result, naive comparisons can be badly confounded. The routing example is especially clear: if harder prompts are systematically sent to larger models, raw logged outcomes can make the larger model look worse.

Third, the paper discusses practical principles for applying causal inference in LLM settings, including identifiability, confounding control, overlap, robustness, and the use of modern causal ML tools in high-dimensional regimes. It does not present one unified estimator, but it does make a concrete case for why observational analysis is often insufficient and where causal methods can improve statistical validity and data efficiency.

From a pretraining perspective, the most useful move is the explicit treatment of data-mixture design as an intervention problem. That framing naturally leads to counterfactual questions: what would have happened if a domain had been excluded, or if its weight had changed, after accounting for interactions with tokenizer behavior, training budget, curriculum, and evaluation overlap?
summary_en.experiments:
The paper is not centered on a new empirical benchmark result. Instead, it builds its case through scenario analysis and examples showing how naive observational comparisons can fail in LLM development and evaluation. There is no single large-scale experimental section with the kind of parameter-count and performance tables one would expect from a methods paper.

What it does provide is a structured account of failure modes: routing-induced difficulty bias, style and length bias in human preference data, systematic bias in arena or judge-based evaluation, and feedback loops in sequential agent settings. The empirical value is therefore illustrative rather than benchmark-driven.

If judged purely by headline numbers, the paper is light. If judged as a guide for experimental design and interpretation, it is more useful: it gives concrete examples of where offline conclusions can be misleading and where causal estimators or randomized designs would be better aligned with the actual engineering question.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read with a concrete problem in mind rather than linearly as a general survey.

If your focus is pretraining, start with the introduction and the sections on pretraining data decisions. The key point is why data mixture changes should be treated as interventions rather than ordinary hyperparameter tuning.

If you care more about evaluation and alignment, focus on the sections on human preferences, LLM-as-a-judge, arenas, and routing. Those sections are the most actionable because they spell out specific sources of bias that often appear in practice.

A useful reading lens is to ask three questions in each section: what is the treatment, what is the context, and what is the outcome? Why can’t logged data be compared directly? And what identification assumption would be hardest to justify in practice? Reading it this way is more productive than treating it as a broad conceptual essay.

The main thread can be covered in about 20–30 minutes. Applying the ideas seriously would require additional background in causal inference.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫因果图和 LLM data-mixture 案例；它不会给 recipe，但能提醒你别把混杂的 ablation 当因果结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the causal graphs and the data-mixture examples; it will not give a recipe, but it usefully warns against reading confounded ablations as causal effects.

paper.title: Trust but Verify: Prover-Verifier Deliberation for Selective LLM Prediction
paper.abstract: Reliably knowing when a language model is correct is almost as important as being correct. We introduce prover-verifier deliberation (PVD), an inference-time protocol grounded in interactive proof theory, as a mechanism for selective prediction: the protocol produces both an answer and a structured confidence verdict, allowing a system to report high-confidence answers while abstaining on uncertain cases. In each dialogue, a prover defends a candidate answer through checkable sub-claims while a

summary.core_problem: 论文关注 LLM 的选择性预测：模型不仅要回答问题，还要知道哪些答案可以高置信输出、哪些应该拒答。核心问题不是提高平均准确率，而是把推理过程转化为可用的置信信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train、推理时计算和 verifier 设计有参考意义。它把 interactive proof 的 prover-verifier 结构移植到冻结 LLM 的推理流程中，用结构化挑战替代简单自一致性投票。价值在于提醒：verifier 不一定只服务于最终打分，也可以通过多轮质询产生覆盖率-精度曲线，用于判断模型输出是否可用。这对后续训练 verifier、构造过程监督数据、设计 abstention-aware evaluation 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: PVD 使用两个冻结模型，一个作为 prover，一个作为 verifier。prover 先给出候选答案，并把理由拆成 3–5 个可检查的 atomic sub-claims。verifier 不直接给置信分，而是在每轮给出 Accept、Challenge 或 Reject。Challenge 时，verifier 选择最可疑或最缺证据的子命题发问；prover 需要补充论证，也允许修改答案。若 verifier 接受且答案没有被修改，则记为 Accept + No Change，即 ANC。论文把 ANC 当作高置信覆盖集合，用它评估 selective prediction 的 precision 和 coverage。与 self-consistency 的区别是，PVD 的置信信号来自有目标的反证搜索，而不是多个采样答案的一致性；与 multi-agent debate 的区别是，PVD 强制把理由拆成可挑战的子命题，并要求 verifier 做明确裁决。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 GPQA Diamond 和 Humanity’s Last Exam 上进行，并和 self-consistency k=8、multi-agent debate、Universal Self-Consistency、Reflexion 对比。GPQA Diamond 上，ANC 子集的高置信精度为 84–98%，覆盖率为 43–77%；相对非 ANC 样本，精度高出 6.6–34.8 个百分点。最强信号来自同系列但能力不完全对称的组合：GPT-5.4 prover 配 GPT-5.4-mini verifier，ANC 精度 97.6%，覆盖率 43%，比非 ANC 样本高 34.8 个百分点。HLE 上的结果更不稳定，弱 prover-verifier 组合可能出现 Accept/Reject 准确率差距缩小甚至反转，说明该协议只有在 verifier 足够可靠时才有校准价值。这个负结果很重要：PVD 不是形式化 soundness 的直接替代，而是一种经验性置信机制。
